abstract: The purpose of this study was to investigate the effect of two nucleoside anticancer drugs, 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) and 5-azacitidine (5-aza), on the development of mouse embryos. The study was performed as described following: (a) mouse embryos were culture in CZB medium supplemented with 5-FU or 5-aza; (b) mouse embryos derived from 5-FU or 5-aza treated mice were cultured in CZB medium. The developmental ability of mouse embryos cultured in vitro was used to assess the effect of two drugs on the development of mouse embryos. (c) female mice were treated with 5-FU, the rate of abnormal neonatal mice was used to assess the teratogenicity of 5-FU. The results showed that both drugs could prevent mouse embryos developing in vitro; moreover, most of embryos derived from 5-FU treated mice lost developmental ability, but few of these embryos could still develop to term, and neonatal mice did not exhibited abnormal phenotype.

articleTitle: Complexity analysis of dichotomy method in solving the approximated solution of equations
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The dichotomy method is a classic way of solving the approximated solution of equations. In the actual teaching process, due to the lack of knowledge about the dichotomy method's complexity, teachers can not answer the question about the advantages of dichotomy method raised by students-“why we choose the dichotomy method for solving equations, but not k-dichotomy method, what are the advantages of dichotomy method?”. This paper analyzes the complexity of the dichotomy method from a tree structure perspective. A general conclusion is obtained which can be used as an assisted teaching content in the teaching process of the dichotomy method.

articleTitle: Synthesis and biological evaluation of resveratrol analogues as anti-bacterial agents
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Resveratrol (3,5,4'-trihydroxy-trans-stilbene) is a stilbenoid, a type of natural phenol, and a phytoalexin produced naturally by several kinds of plants when under attack by pathogens such as bacteria or fungi which exerts a variety of biological activities. In this work, several resveratrol derivatives were designed and synthesized through a four-step convenient synthetic procedure. Six newly synthesized compounds were characterized on the basis of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>H NMR and mass spectra. Also, these compounds were tested for their biological activities against Gram<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> and Gram<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> bacteria. Through the analysis on the results of the anti-bacterial activity test, a preliminary structure-activity relationship was obtained which indicated that the trans-stilbene structure and the phenolic hydroxyl group (also the acetoxyl group), especially the para-phenolic hydroxyl group are the two key structures for their anti-bacterial activities in this type of molecules.

articleTitle: A forecast of coal demand based on the simultaneous equations model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Based on the summary of the methods of coal demand forecasting, this article conducts the empirical analysis of the impact of electric power production on the demand of coal of China through Granger causality test and simultaneous equations model and predicts the trend of Chinese coal demand. Then the article puts forward some suggestions to the policy of strengthening coal demand management.

articleTitle: Analysis of the 4G technologic requirements and key technology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The mobile communication technology has been developed for three generations. Although the 3G Mobile Communication system can provide many wide frequence belt information services which the former two generations can't offer, it still has limitation that especially follows the structure of 2G system, which leads to the dissatisfiction of intelligence by mobile terminal. So the 4G system has been taken into consideration. The paper analyzes the technological requirements and technology of 4G Mobile Communication.

articleTitle: Particle filter resampling based on optimized combinatorial algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In particle Alter algorithm, the resampling step effectively solves the problem of particles degeneracy; however, it reduces the particle variety. This article describes how to use chaos, immunity algorithm and genetic algorithm carried on particle resampling corrective method. We present a novel algorithm which combines immune algorithm, chaos and genetic algorithm. This immune genetic algorithm based on chaos initializes cluster by the over-spread character and randomicity of chaos to improve search speed and renews cluster by chaos sequence and enhancing cluster diversity to avoid local optimization. Chaos also is adopts to optimize the local optimization to increase precision. After crossover and mutation, using chaotic local optimization near the optimal solution to enhance the precision of the solutions. The experimental results show that it has the quicker convergence rate and the better iterative estimating capability, compared with the particle resampling based on the immunity genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: A more efficient link-state routing algorithm for telecommunication networks
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: An efficient K-shortest paths routing algorithm for computer networks is presented. The Algorithm is based on enhancements to currently used link-state routing algorithms such as OSPF, which is only focusing on finding the shortest path route by Dijkstra algorithm. The desire effect to achieve is mainly through the use of K-shortest paths algorithm, which has been implemented successfully in some fields like traffic engineering. The correctness of this Algorithm is discussed as long as the comparison with OSPF.

articleTitle: PSO algorithm with stochastic inertia weight and its application in clustering
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: PSO algorithm with stochastic inertia weight has better converging speed and ability than the basic PSO algorithm. The PSO algorithm with stochastic inertia is analyzed, and is applied to the clustering algorithm. The data sets of UCI data collection are used to experiment, the results of the experiment shows that the new clustering algorithm is better than K-means algorithm in quantization error, and the result of clustering is not affected by the size of the particle swarm. The application in instruction websites of the new clustering algorithm is discussed.

articleTitle: A tele-healthcare framework implementation for family and community
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper presents a tele-healthcare framework and its implemented system for family and community use. The framework illustrated in this paper concludes the key elements that ubiquitous healthcare applications should involve, including the architecture, devices, data models and applications. Based on it, an applicable system is introduced including family health monitoring devices and a community healthcare kiosk. Any service provider can use this framework to develop their own telemedicine systems and services; home and community users can simply make their healthcare connected and managed. At the end of the paper, the implemented results of the system are shown.

articleTitle: Research on survival model of casualty in wartime
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The objective of this paper is to explore the survival model of casualty in wartime using expert questionnaires and survival curve fitting. First, the survival probability data of wartime casualty were collected using expert questionnaires. Then, these data were fitted by the Weibull survival function with MATLAB and the casualty survival functions based on type of medical treatment facility (MTF) and treatment delay were obtained. At last, on the basis of above research, the final casualty survival model based on any treatment delay was obtained. The survival model developed will contribute to timeliness treatment and wartime medical evacuation simulation.

articleTitle: The design Of VGA data communication based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The method of controlling the VGA data communication using FPGA was introduced, emphatically in researches and designs of the VGA signal and FPGA important modules. It has analyzed the FIFO module, the VGA control module in the design, has given its top layer module design and the timing function simulation. This design uses the hardware description language Verilog programming, had the high accuracy sequential logic using FPGA to guarantee real-time data acquisition and the accuracy of the high speed transmission, simultaneously could display on the graphic display device correctly and stably.

articleTitle: The study on antioxidant activity and content of total flavonoidsand total phenolic in different parts of Abelmoschus esculentus L.
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This article determined total flavonoids and total phenolic content of extracts from different parts of Abelmoschus esculentus L. and enrichment of macroporous resins with different parts. At the same time, their antioxidant activity in vitro, total flavonoids and total phenolic content and determination of two different methods of analysis of the correlation between the results were determined by DPPH and FRAP methods applied.The results demonstrate that different parts of Abelmoschus esculentus L. contain a lot of flavonoids and phenolic acids composition, and that they show a strong free radical scavenging activity and reducing power. This shows that the main ingredients of Abelmoschus esculentus L. playing the antioxidant effect was flavonoids and phenolic acids,This implies that Abelmoschus esculentus L. is a kind of antioxidant potential resources.

articleTitle: Research on risk management and control system for information security K-PRS-ISMCS based on knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, according to the characteristics of organization's Information Systems (IS), knowledge resources related to IS are classified into three parts. Based on knowledge management of the three perspectives -Process Controlling, Resources Protecting and Realization of Security Objectives for IS, elements of information security risk and their relationships are analyzed, and then the three-dimensional model of security risk management and control system K-PRS-ISMCS is built; lastly the improved management and control framework K-PRS-PDCA based on perspectives of organizations' management and life cycle of Information Systems is set up.

articleTitle: Gait recognition using shape trace transform
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Normally, the gait of each person has individual style so it can be used for human identification. In this paper, the gait recognition using shape trace transform is presented for human identification. First step, gait recognition using shape trace transform used the silhouettes input. The gait period could be estimated by computing the median of the walking step width of the three consecutive maxima. After that, the silhouettes in one period are transformed by trace transform. Next, the trace transform pictures in one period are calculated for finding the average trace transform. The average trace transform images are defined the threshold value for finding the shape trace transform which have significance different. Finally, the shape context and Euclidean distance are used for identification. The results of gait recognition using trace transform can identify the person by their gait.

articleTitle: Enhancement and edge detection of images by spline dyadic wavelets
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Dyadic wavelet transform is suitable for enhancement and edge detection of images since it has a shift-invariant property. Especially, spline dyadic wavelet transform provides excellent enhancement and edge detection techniques because of the smoothness and compact support of box-spline functions. This paper gives a sufficient condition for constructing spline dyadic wavelet filters, and designs some of them under the sufficient condition. Fast dyadic wavelet transform having these filters is applied to enhancement and edge detection of medical images, which helps the diagnosis of illness by medical doctors.

articleTitle: Research and application of distribution practice platform for e-commerce entrepreneurship education
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to carry out entrepreneurship education for college students, train and improve e-commerce practical capability of college students better, this paper analyzes and illustrates the design idea, establishment of distribution channels, function design and realization of establishing distribution practice platform for e-commerce entrepreneurship education. The platform establishes entrepreneurship distribution channels and provides a zero inventory, zero risk e-commerce distribution practice platform for college students. This paper completes the analysis, design and development of the distribution practice platform for e-commerce entrepreneurship education based on the existing ceramics e-commerce Website, and gives an application case of the platform.

articleTitle: Biomechanical analysis of shoulder and hip angle in tennis technique of two-handed backhand slap topspin
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The batting technology rationality is very important in tennis playing. It has a direct impact on the athlete's sports performance and health. Two-handed backhand batting technology is a weak item in most athletes' integral technology. This research studies the two-handed backhand slap topspin by high-speed photography technology and surface EMG technique. Biomechanics analysis show that the shoulder and hip angle change in the entire motion process of batting is based on the difference of the muscle discharge in left and right sides of the trunk, and shoulder and hip angle change in the front cross hit stage is mainly a left anterior deltoid contraction discharge results. According to the results of this study, we suggest coaches and athletes should strengthen the exercise of the muscle groups which affect the shoulder and hip angle change to improve the athletes' two-handed backhand topspin technical rationality.

articleTitle: The research and exploration of digital signature in teaching management system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper puts forward a digital signature scheme in teaching management software by means of novel and lightweight digital signature algorithm, points out the scheme's setting of databases and the implement process of function modules, and solves coexisting problems of computer management and labor management in information teaching and learning management.

articleTitle: PKD3 is required for prostratin-activated HIV-1 transcription
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Prostratin has been shown to promote transcriptional activation of HIV-1 provirus, however, the underlying mechanism is not fully understood. By using HeLa cells with a stably integrated HIV-LTR-Luciferase gene as a reporter system, we investigated the role of protein kinase D (PKD) in HIV-1 activation by prostratin treatment. Knocking-down of PKD3, but not PKD1 or PKD2, inhibited both the basal and prostratin-induced HIV-LTR-Luciferase expression. Moreover, prostratin triggered PKD3 activation by inducing the phosphorylation of its activation loop. Furthermore, the overexpression of constitutively active form of PKD3, but not the wild type or kinase dead form of PKD3, augmented HIV-LTR-Luciferase expression. These results suggest that activated PKD3 is critical for prostratin stimulating HIV-LTR transcription.

articleTitle: Training investigation of hospital nurses on disaster nursing
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: Find out the situation of knowledge of hospital nurses on disaster nursing, do disaster nursing training, and give a method on how to build a professional team of disaster nursing. Methods: First, Investigation was executed on 195 hospital nurses on disaster nursing knowledge, second, some professional training was done on them, and last, comparisons before and after the training were given. Results: 32% of the hospital nurses know disaster nursing knowledge before training, and 51.7% of them know it after training; 41.5% of the hospital nurses know disaster nursing operation before training, and 58.9% of them know it after training (P<0.01). Conclusion: Hospital nurses was lack of disaster nursing knowledge, and after training, the situation was improved greatly. So it is necessary to train hospital nurses on disaster nursing, and build a professional nurse team on disaster nursing.

articleTitle: Civil engineering technology class international research training model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Article under construction technology training international background of the times, made a technical international civil personnel should have five main features, and international talent on the construction technology of the industry demand conditions in-depth investigation and analysis, which launched a civil engineering technology training model of international exploration and practice of similar institutions in the international engineering education has a positive reference.

articleTitle: Analysis on data for detection of lung cancer using serum auto-fluorescence
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, the lung cancer and control group were detected using laser induced auto-fluorescence spectra of human serum. The results show that three fluorescence intensity ratios existed obvious difference between the lung cancer and control group. Then linear discriminant analysis was used on the three ratios, and a total diagnosis accuracy of 83.3% was obtained.

articleTitle: The mathematics model for optimum arrangement of the sickbeds of Ophthalmology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The problem of reasonable arrangement for the sickbeds is an important factor in the improvement of service level of Dept. of Ophthalmology. In the article, firstly, by the analysis of the working mechanism in Dept. of Ophthalmology, we set up a sickbed arrangement evaluation system which consists of 4 indexes. They are the length of queue, the number of inpatients who are discharged from hospital per unit time, FCFS (First coming, First serving) and giving priority to the patient who suffers from surgical trauma. Secondly, we establish a model in reasonable arrangement of sickbeds in Dept. of Ophthalmology, called Multi-muzzle Type Ammunition Case, and got the total number of inpatients who are discharged from hospital in a week and the average waiting time of inpatients. Furthermore, we got the time, which inpatients are hospitalized. That improved working efficiency, resource's effective utilization ratio and the humanized service level.

articleTitle: Research on resource allocation method in universities based on user participation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Resource allocation problem in universities belongs to office automation research issues, which is one of the important businesses for management departments in universities. Aiming at “Just, Fair and Open” principle and purpose of user-oriented resource management, rational allocation by means of informatization and efficient use of resources is certainly an effective way. In this paper, we study the problem of resource allocation method in universities with user participation. A layered reference model of reservation system for university resources is presented. Taking multiple constraints into account, including user satisfaction, resource utilization, user coverage etc., the resource allocation is made much fit to the actual situation, however, the problem complexity increases correspondingly, leading to the adoption of an intelligent algorithm solution. Hence, an improved ant-colony-optimization-based resource allocation algorithm with user participation is proposed. By feasibility analysis of algorithm, it is shown that the proposed algorithm to solve the multi-objective optimization problem with multi-constraint is feasible and valid. As the layered idea of the model is applicable to other system, so it has broad application value.

articleTitle: Research on a correlation between Cox-2 protein expression and the resistance of radiation therapy in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective To study a correlation between the resistance of radiation therapy in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and Cox-2 protein expression for cancer organization before radiation therapy. Methods 76 cases were treated by pathology and confirmed the diagnosis of patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, and all by radical radiation therapy for 6MV X-ray, illuminated the dose of 60 Gy. According to the radiation effect, they are divided into Radiation Resistance Group and Radiation Sensitive Group. Using the immunohistochemical SP method, these two groups of cancer organizations are given COX-2 detection and also contrast analysis. Results COX-2 protein expressions for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma in Radiation Resistance Group and sensitivity Group are 85.71% and 30.91%, Resistance Group is significantly higher than sensitivity group (P <; 0.05). Conclusion In esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, high expression of COX-2 can cause tumors to resist the radiation, expression level of COX-2 can be regarded as an important index to predict radiation sensitivity of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and short-term curative effect of radiation therapy.

articleTitle: An improved protocol for efficient one-step PCR site-directed mutagenesis with partial-overlapping primers
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Described here is an improved protocol of the reported method for one-step PCR site-directed mutagenesis with partial-overlapping primers [1]. The improvements include the new design of partial-overlapping primers, and optimized PCR amplification at the annealing temperature of 60°C, instead of recommended 52°C. Under such conditions, the non-specific PCR products could be remarkably reduced or even completely eliminated. Sufficient amount of specific PCR products were obtained, which allowed not only to omit the gel purification step from the reported protocol and making the procedures automated, but also to markedly reduce the cost of mutagenesis experiments.

articleTitle: Reform and practice on self-determination experiment in computer basic teaching
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to optimize experimental teaching of computer basic teaching, this paper proposes self-determination experiment in computer basic teaching. The paper aims some disadvantages of practice teaching, reforms in many aspects, and carries out experiments in VB programming. The experimental result indicates that self-determination experiment model is better than traditional experimental model in autonomy ability, practical ability and thinking ability. It provides a wider platform support and a learning model based on self-determination expermient for independent learning and personalized learning.

articleTitle: Development of species-specific SCAR (sequence-characterized amplified region) markers for identification of famous-region drug Ophiopogon japonicus (L.f.) Ker-Gawl
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Correct genotype identification of medicinal plant material remains important for Chinese traditional medicine. Limitations of chemical and morphological approaches for authentication have generated need for newer methods in discrimination of famous-region herbal medicines. The present study was carried out to develop DNA based markers for identification of Chinese famous-region drug Ophiopogon japonicus (L.f.) Ker-Gawl. Two specific RAPD fragments R01 (268bp) and R02 (1364bp) for famous-region drug Ophiopogon japonicus (L.f.) Ker-Gawl were identified by Random Amplified Polymorphic DNA (RAPD). Sequence Characterized Amplified Region (SCAR) markers (248bp & 631bp) were developed from the RAPD amplicon. The SCAR markers were found useful for identification of genuine regional Ophiopogon japonicus ( L.f. ) Ker-Gawl in four different populations.

articleTitle: The primary culture of vascular endothelial cell in rat
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The purpose of the experiment: to explore the primary cultural method of vascular endothelial cell in rat that we have got through obtained and cultivated, the experiment were provided to the corresp technique of the further research. Experimental methods: the aorta of Wistar rat was obtained in operating microscope, then removal the adventitia and adipose tissue. The blood vessel were sheared like the organization by 1mm×1mm. Using stationary culture in DMEM/F12 culture medium contained fetal bovine serum (FBS). The results of experiment: endothelial cell swimmed from the borderline of organization to grow by adherence after three days. Then the cell began to synthesis after 10 to 12 days and were confluenced to monolayer about 70%. The passage cell were grew prosperity from the digest of diastase vera and were converged like the cobblestone characteristic of endothelial cell. The method of experiment was convenient and economy, we can obtain vascular endothelial cell in high fineness without collagenase and the supplement of endothelial cell in cell growth.

articleTitle: Systemic administration of drag-reducing polymers may be a novel and effective treatment for acute lung injury
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Over the past several decades, blood-soluble drag reducing polymers (DRPs) have been shown to significantly enhance hemodynamics and improve hemorheology in various animal models when added to blood at nanomolar concentrations. Meanwhile, many more researchers appreciate that hemorheology abnormality underlies in acute lung injury (ALI) pathogenesis, especially in neutrophils extravasation mechanism. Therefore, we hypothesize that owing to DRPs' peculiarity to reduce microvascular resistance increase blood flow, and so on, systemic administration of DRPs may be a novel and effective treatment for ALI.

articleTitle: Risk management of education information
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Educational information promote the field of education the changes taking place at various levels, create more social benefits for education. Educational information also introduce more risks to educational process, these risks constitute important constraining factor in the educational benefits generated. In this paper, introduced risk management mechanisms into planning and implementation of the education information technology, analyzed the educational information in a different phase characterized by five steps of risk management, information technology effectively to improved the effectiveness of education and promoted risk management of information technology in education mechanism for improving the process.

articleTitle: The effect of animation presentation strategies on the achievement of multimedia learning
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The aim of this study was to explore the effect of animation presentation strategies on the achievement of multimedia learning. 120 high school students were asked to complete the experiment. It was found that (1) learner-controlled pacing strategy and meta-cognitive monitoring guidance could improve the achievement of multimedia learning, and(2) adding meta-cognitive monitoring guidance to learner-controlled pacing was the best animation presentation strategy to multimedia learning effect.

articleTitle: Effects of gender and exercise training on static postural balance of college students: A quantitative comparison analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Using the Tetrax test instrument, respectively, we have tested the static balance ability of aerobics group and as a special reference general group in order to explore gender and exercise training on static balance ability of young people. By detecting the indicators, that is A%, B%, C%, D%, WDI and LEFT of eight position (NO, NC, PO, PC, HR, HL, HB, HF), found that the influence of gender for aerobics exercisers is mainly in body weight distribution. Compared with male, the weight distribution of female indulges in the heel, while the male indulge in toe. Secondly, the visual, vestibular, and somato-sensory sense of female, to some extent, better than male. But the central integration and muscle strength of male are better than female, therefore, the physical coordination of male better than female in the standard position. Again, the indicators between the general group and aerobics group of male and female in NO were not significantly different, therefore, when there is no special requirements on the balance, gender may not do too much to consider, but if a certain feeling is required particularly, gender should be considered. Finally, after training, some balance indicators will be enlarged between male and female.

articleTitle: The influence of partial volume effect on the finite element modeling of bone
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Providing useful information on the geometrical topology and material properties, CT data has been widely used in the finite element modeling of bone. Many researches have demonstrated the relationship of apparent density of bone tissues and Hounsfield Unit (HU) and various empirical relationships between Young's modulus and the apparent bone density have been established. Due to the partial volume effect, especially the edge part of tissue, the HU value would be lowered down and further affect the reliability of FEM. By applying two methods for material assignment with one HU related and another HU unrelated on the same femoral CT data, this study is aimed to present the influence of partial volume effect on the finite element bone modeling.

articleTitle: Research on the security protection based on spatiotemporal chaos technology for the video resource of network education
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The network technology, multimedia technology and communication technology are widely used in all kinds of education areas. The network-teaching is a novel application result for higher education in the information age. However, it is an increasingly outstanding problem for the management and security in the resource library of the network teaching and education. By the characteristics of chaotic theory and encryption, in this paper, a kind of secure communication system based on spatiotemporal chaos is designed and exploited for solving the security protection problem of network-teaching video resource. By using Visual C++ platform, an illustrative example is realized and its experimental results demonstrate that the online video-teaching resource is protected very well during the encrypted transmission based on the spatiotemporal chaotic technology.

articleTitle: A human face recognition method by improved Modular 2DPCA
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The Modular-2DPCA is an improvement and promotion of 2DPCA. Modular-2DPCA method creates the covariance matrix by blocked sub image, which make better robustness. There are many parts in a human face, with each part could own different weight in face recognition, block made the research of parts became possible. This paper directs the characteristic of block, calculating the mean value and covariance matrix for each sub image block, with which can extract the features of each part of human face more accurate. Theoretically, this method can efficacious reduce the effect of changed facial. Otherwise, this paper contains a preliminary research of sub image weights setting. Weights of parts can further raise contribution of some special parts of human face. Appropriate weights can improve the result of recognition. Experiments show that this method can efficacious improves the insignificancy of Modular 2DPCA in features extracting and raise the correct result of recognition.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of three-dimensional model of instruction of “Automobile Structure” course
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: “Automobile Structure” is a important course with great theoretical and practical meaning. During the teaching, we combine preview, homework, class instruction, model, material and practical instruction with internet teaching organically. Through new-type and rich teaching contents, intuitional and on-the-spot teaching, flexible and various teaching methods, we have and formed a three-dimensional model of teaching which is beneficial to the improvement of students' comprehensive capacity and acquired good efficiencies through many years' practice as well.

articleTitle: The ecophysiological response of three shrub species to flooding
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: It is important to understand the ecophysiological adaptation of plants to flooding stress for selecting pioneer species to restore riparian vegetation. Three shrub species distributing in the Three Gorges Reservoir area, including Myricaria laxiflora, Salix variegata and Buxus ichangensis, were studied by simulating flooding, and their ecophysiological responses were uncovered. The results showed that M. laxiflora had the strongest adaptation to flooding, S. variegata and B. ichangensis ranked the second and the third respectively. Short time flooding resulted in continue decline of physiological activity in photosynthesis and transpiration. However, physiological activity of plants would gradually become stable and maintain at a certain level to keep their life. Flooding also caused the decrease of leaf chlorophyll and carotenoid contents, but the chlorophyll a/b ratio rises to improve the photosynthetic efficiency. The three shrub species also changed in morphological characteristics and life history to adapt flooding in an integrated mechanism. M. laxiflora became rest during flooding season meanwhile S. variegata and B. ichangensis developed adventitious roots to increase oxygen supply.

articleTitle: Founding family control, information disclosure and equity capital cost
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: High-quality information can decrease information asymmetry between corporation and investors, thereby decreases equity capital cost. Using sample of refinancing from 2003 to 2007, this paper explores influence mechanism of family controls has on the relationship between information disclosure and equity capital cost. The research indicates that equity capital cost of corporation controlled by founding family is significantly lower than that of other corporations. Furthermore, under different ownerships, different relationships exist between information disclosure and equity capital cost. As to founding family, the long-term operation feature helps to reduce the transaction cost, and becomes the substitute of high-quality information disclosure.

articleTitle: An inquiry-based learning approach on a educational technology course
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of utilizing the inquiry-based learning approach to aid vocational school students on multimedia project design and development. The results indicate after a period of time there is a difference in student achievement between the inquiry-based learning approach and the traditional didactic instruction. In addition, based upon the experience on the inquiry-based learning process of developing learning tasks, most of the students reveal positive and favorable feelings toward their learning attitude, learning ability, and the online learning environment.

articleTitle: Construction of curriculum according to a competency-based curriculum framework for the specialty of health information management in higher vocational colleges
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Nowadays, the graduates of the specialty of health information management from higher vocational colleges lack competitive power in the job market, which reflect the problems of education. Curriculum, developed to enable students to obtain appropriate knowledge and skills in a range of related disciplines, plays the most significant role in education. In order to promote the competency of graduates and help them adapt to the job market's demand, a competency-based curriculum framework is proposed in the paper. Furthermore, the process of curriculum construction in the specialty of health information management based on the proposed curriculum framework will be described in great detail. During the implementation, an investigation study related to positions' requirement is adopted and presented, which help planners to confirm the competencies and orientation of specialty. Considering the competencies as a vital point, a curriculum plan is identified with an introduction to detailed course module. Finally, the characteristics of the presented curriculum are analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Campus-centric distance education using Wimba Live Classroom
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper describes the experience of deploying the University of Arkansas at Little Rock (UALR) Master of Science in Information Quality as a combined on-campus distance education program since the fall of 2007. The program is unusual in that the distance education component is tied directly to the on-campus classes. All classes supporting the program are scheduled in regular on-campus classrooms and are webcast using the Wimba Live Classroom® function of Blackboard®, a commercial distance learning system. The paper also discusses the advantages of distance education using the campus-centric webcast approach as well as some of its challenges.

articleTitle: A collaborative filtering algorithm based on memory
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Collaborative filtering is one of the most successful technologies for building recommender system. However, existing collaborative filtering algorithms can not promptly reflect the change of users' interest. For this reason, this paper introduces the human brain's characteristics of memory and forgetting to personalized recommendation, and proposes a collaborative filtering algorithm based on memory. On the one hand, the effective use of short-term memory reflects users' recent interest; On the other hand, long-term memory emphasizes the importance of users' early interest; at the same time, it combines the short-term memory with the long-term memory and proposes the reconciled memory, which makes the recommender system adaptively track the change of users' interest. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm has higher accuracy than existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on adult and continuing education based on distance education
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper studies the application of distance education carried out in scattered learning position. The role of teacher and communication are studied based on participant adult and continuing education students in a distance class. The result of study demonstrated the different effects of teacher's teaching effectiveness such as expending, rhetorical and provocative. Further, teach in distance education class lacks communication often fails and proper system back-channel cues as a teaching result feedback. The study result also shows that there is balance lack between the students and teacher in the distribution of understand, eventually leading to interaction is in one-way. Normally, the students become an recipients in class reacting against lack feedback. Statement and question posed by teacher is designed to break the barriers through mediating technology. Also Both sides of teacher and student are frequently impaired by practice, misunderstand is described as a education space connected by the communication technology.

articleTitle: An investigation on the subjectivity-oriented education of nursing students
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: to understand the current state of nursing students' subjectivity-oriented education and explore the teaching policies to develop it. Method: using random sampling, a self-designed questionnaire is administered among the nursing students who attended university in the year between 2005 to 2008. Result: most of the nursing students lack subjectivity in their study. Senior students' subjectivity in their study is higher than that of the lower grade students. Conclusion: to develop students' subjectivity according to the characteristics of different students'.

articleTitle: Research on the general ideas and target mode of the reform and development for sports management system in the university
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The universities athletics produces with the reform and development of higher education and athletics sports. But many problems has directly affected its healthy and sustainable development such as low, standstill management, inferior self-development ability, and etc. Among them, the basic reason is the backwardness of our management system. In order to study the athletics management system of universities in china under new situations, in this paper, we discussed the general ideas, target mode of the reform and development for sports management system in the university. Based on deep analyzing the necessity of reforming and developing the sports management system in universities, according the situation and requirements of the politics, economy, social reform and development, we proposed general ideas and target mode of the reform and development for sports management system in the university from the perspective of theoretical research.

articleTitle: The impact on students' thinking mode by learning the Medical Information Analysis & Decision-making course
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: To train computing thinking skills in learning the Medical Information Analysis and Decision-making course is an exciting process of experiencing a new thinking mode for medical students whose basic thinking-mode is experimental thinking and image thinking. Medical students personally went through training the skills of their computing thinking while analyzing and reasoning an uncertainty problem and making a decision around medical data of the case. By synthetically applying various thinking skills, medical students can effectively improve their ability of practice and innovation.

articleTitle: Effects of temperature on the SDA of the brook trout
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Specific dynamic action (SDA), the metabolic phenomenon resulting from the digestion and assimilation of a meal, is generally influenced by temperature. The effects of temperature (5.5±0.5, 8.5±0.5, 11.5±0.5, 14.5±0.5, 17.5±0.5°C) on SDA of brook trout (Salvelinus fontinalus Mitchill) was evaluated, by measuring the temporal pattern of the oxygen consumption rates, after feeding. Peak VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> (highest recorded oxygen consumption rate following feeding) and SDAE (energy expended on SDA) increased slowly to a maximum at 14.5±0.5°C, and then decreased at 17.5±0.5 °C. The relationships between Peak VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> (mg·kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>·h<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>), the SDA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">E</inf> (kJ·kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>) and temperature (t, °C) were respectively described as: Peak VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> = −0.1332t<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> + 5.6612t<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> −86.317t<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> + 581.33t − 1275.3, SDA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">E</inf> = −23.59t<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> + 999.28t<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> − 15303t<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> + 101913t − 229665 (n=650, R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> = 1, 4.5<t<17.5). The results of Peak VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and SDA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">E</inf> showed that the optimum growth of brook trout occurred at 14.5±0.5□. Duration decreased from 28±0.7h to 16±0.6h as the temperature increased from 5.5±0.5 to 17.5±0.5°C. The relationship between duration (h) and temperature (t, °C) was described as: duration = −0.0051t<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> + 0.2305t<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> − 3.767t<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> + 25.724t −33.167, (n=650, R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> = 1, 4.5<t<17.5).

articleTitle: Personalized automatic recommendations for the web-based autonomous language learning system based on data mining technology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Web-based autonomous language learning system enjoys great popularity among college English learners in China. It provides abundant educational resources for the learner. Efficient use of available materials on the system needs intelligent resources recommendation and personalized guidance in learning strategies. This paper uses the data mining technology to build an automatic recommendation agent to enhance the function of web-based autonomous language learning system. The automatic recommendation agent serves two functions. One is to push related resources to the learner based on the results from association rule mining of all users' resource navigation patterns. The other is to provide immediate and individualized guidance for the learner concerning strategies of online language learning. The knowledge of personalized guidance comes from the machine learning of strategies adopted by students with varied level of achievements in language learning. The framework and data structure of its implementation have been presented in this paper. Experiments show that the automatic recommendation agent improves the management of educational resources on web-based autonomous language learning system and better facilitate students' language learning.

articleTitle: Online course quality factor analysis based on fuzzy mathematics
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Nowadays, the online course has become one of the most important ways in education, and the quality of online course is influenced by some factor, such as self-teaching ability, teaching assistance, the difficulty of course and the quality of lecture note. For finding the weights of the factors, this paper purpose a model based on fuzzy mathematics for factor analysis in the online course quality evaluation. By applying the survey data in our model, we find out that most student are very much rely on teaching assistance in the online course, and the student with good ability of self-teaching are rely on the quality of teaching software, meanwhile we find that the sophistic theory is not suitable for online course.

articleTitle: Tumor sphere, a survival predictor for glioma
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The glioma stem-like cells (GSLCs) played important roles in glioma genesis. Tumor spheres, a robust index reflecting the behavior of GSLCs, was often used to isolate the ones. We planted tumor spheres or adherent tumor cells from glioma cell lines into the rats, respectively. We assessed the survival time of the grafted rats and subcutaneous tumor sizes in grafted rats. Results showed that the rats seeded intracranially with tumor spheres had shorter survival time, and the rats grafted subcutaneously enjoyed larger tumor sizes as compared with those seeded with the adherent tumor cells. This study implied that the ability of tumor sphere formation could be considered as a predictive factor to evaluate the survival situation of glioma animal.

articleTitle: Parameter on algorithm analysis of the impact
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper introduces a new optimization algorithm - Election Campaign Optimization algorithm, which searches solution space by simulating the motivation of candidates in election campaign to the highest support. This algorithm is realized by Matlab language, and be encapsulated to the algorithm toolbox. The computational results of function in the toolbox show that ECO algorithm can search out the optimal solutions of optimization problems.

articleTitle: The analysis of key technologies and development trend for a new generation satellite navigation systems
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the GPS modernization process can move forward and improve the positioning accuracy of the system to expand coverage and improve service continuity, improve system security and anti-jamming, focusing on compatibility and expansion of technology has been applied and implemented. In this paper, a new generation of satellite navigation systems for the key technologies and trends to do a detailed analysis, it will be China's development of space-based navigation system providing a realistic basis.

articleTitle: Research on teaching strategies for “curriculum design” based on constructivism
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This essay explores “Anchored teaching pedagogy” based on constructivist theory in terms of the application of curriculum design, which deals with the “curriculum” teaching characteristics, in the respect of psychological process of learning, curriculum design, the role of cognitive structure. It provides the “curriculum design” teaching strategies for the students to develop their practical and innovative abilities.

articleTitle: Electric power consumption forecast of life energy sources based on fuzzy neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: A fuzzy neural network(FNN) with five layers is proposed in this article. Aim at the structure optimization of network, a new node selection method and corresponding back propagation learning algorithm are presented. We use real history data to train the network model at the same time and to forecast the result after the train finished. Test results illustrate its good practicability to power consumption forecast of life energy sources.

Author Keywords: electric power consumption forecast of life energy sources

articleTitle: SARP: A comprehensive design platform for studying structure-activity relationship of antimicrobial peptides
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Wide-spectrum, rapidness, and specificity in antibacteria, antivirus, and antitumor of antimicrobial peptides, allow for the development of therapeutic agents from numerous antimicrobial peptides. But there are still hemolytic activity which will do harm to multicellular organisms, therefore, molecular design have to face the problem of increasing the lytic activity against pathogen and reducing the hemolytic activity to host. In this study, we constructed a comprehensive design platform for studying structure-activity relationship of antimicrobial peptides (SARP). The platform has integrated a series of tools in order to facilitate efficient extraction of data for further analysis and design at molecular level. These tools included search engine, BLAST, web-based analysis tools, MDtools, etc. Search engine can be run through inputs of keywords or other information about the query sequences, such as ID, length, charge, hydrophobicity, family, structure and activity, etc. BLAST can be used to align the submitted sequence with the sequences in SARP database. Web-based analysis tools provide several services to perform analysis, including physical and chemical features, structure prediction and function prediction. MDtools are used to calculate several parameters, including charge, hydrophobicity, amphipathic tendency to form α-helix. All these can be obtained through web server. Therefore, the SARP platform could provides a powerful tool to serve for new drug development.

articleTitle: Theoretical research on the teaching models of PE distance education
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: PE Distance Education, as a new teaching model, will promote the development of PE education. The paper, using documents and logic analysis, makes a comparison between traditional education and distance education, summarizes the advantages of PE distance education, Constructs a new teaching Model in PE distance education by combining the characteristics of PE courses and puts forward some ideas relating to the development of PE distance education.

articleTitle: Toxicity of the Herbicide Butchlor Effects on early period of postembryonic development of Toad Bufo bufo Gargarizans and Bufo naddei Strauch
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The present study was undertaken to determine the 24-96h LC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub> of herbicide butachlor in the early period of postembryonic development for Bufo bufo Gargarizans and Bufo naddei Strauch and simultaneously observe the developmental changes caused by the toxicity of the herbicide butachlor. At first, 10-20 tadpoles of B. bufo and B.naddei in gosner20 and gosner25 were put into 5 exposure groups and 1 control group respectively, finding their LC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub>s; then chose 60 tadpoles of B.bufo and B.naddei in gosner20 respectively, in accordance with the concentrations of 1/10, 1/100 and 1/1000 of their LC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub>s for exposure, measuring the body length of every group for 5 tadpoles after every 3 days. From the start of exposure, we kept continuous observation on the behavior changes. The most typical symptom of tadpoles in the period of acute experiment was the change of tail swing. The LC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub> values of butachlor of different concentrations were found respectively. In the period of chronic exposure, the body length of B.bufo and B. naddei was affected significantly by the toxicity of the herbicide butachlor. The study shows that maybe tadpoles in the former stage of the early period of postembryonic development have greater tolerance to herbicide butachlor than the tadpoles in the latter stage; and B.naddei has greater tolerance to herbicide butachlor than B.bufo in the early period of postembryonic development.

Author Keywords: LC50 Early period of postembryonic development

articleTitle: Seeking reform paths in medical education from the revelation of Global Commission Report on Lancet
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The Lancet publication of the Global Independent Commission Report on Education of Health Professionals for the 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> Century at the centennial of Flexner Report is a happy turning point in the history of medicine, and shall reset the future of health professionals education. This report made a compelling argument that it is time to carry out third-generation reform in the training of healthcare professionals, and pointed out that despite many impressive innovations that educators have adopted since the Flexner Revolution of 1910, medical education is not yet perfectly aligned with societal needs. The Commission therefore emphasized the realization of transformative learning and interdependence in education through a system approach to institutional and instructional reforms. In this article, in order to answer what kind of health professionals is needed to solve the contemporary and future health problem of society, and to understand what the current medical education and training programs are producing. The authors attempt to reveal some core medical educational notion from this report and their implications for medical education by studying the report as mentioned. Finally, the authors offer some recommendations and paths for advancing third-generation reform including integrating needs assessment into medical curriculum development; innovations that are compatible with mission and goals; making action research to meet the need of stakeholders, and building a sound environment.

articleTitle: Modeling of cardiac electrical activity for characterizing vortex components
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this study, source model for solving biomagnetic inverse problem is developed with a new method, where vortex components along with the flow component of the equivalent source is considered. The model is an aggregation of a single current dipole and a magnetic dipole. The single current dipole denotes the flow component while the magnetic dipole is an abstract of the vortex component of the biomagnetic source. Simulation results indicate that this model could be more efficient for modeling cardiac electrical activity, compared with single current dipole. Despite that this model is more complicated than the single current dipole model; simple algorithm can still be used for solving inverse problem with only small revision. Meaning of the model parameters solved from the inverse problem is also discussed.

articleTitle: Evaluation method for traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis based on two-tuple linguistic
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the development of evidence-based medicine, how to get the rational evidence of diagnosis got more and more attention. For this reason, a evaluation method for traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis based on two-tuple linguistic is proposed in this paper, which can provide a reasonable diagnosis evidence to help doctor select a desirable diagnosis in Treatment. Firstly, according to the method proposed in the paper, a traditional Chinese medicine diagnose evaluation system is established. Then, two-tuple linguistic is used to evaluate traditional Chinese medicine diagnose, the method assists doctors making decision. Finally, a case study is given to illustrate this evaluation method.

Author Keywords: evaluation of traditional Chinese medicine diagnose

articleTitle: The CapSense design in portable media players
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The adoption of capacitive sensing as an interface technology in portable media players and mobile handsets has created demand for the same technology in more conventional consumer electronics. Demand has led to significant innovation and several competitive technologies are available. While these technologies each have their respective differences, the underlying principle is the measurement of capacitance between a plate (the sensor) and its environment. Sensing techniques can employ ADCs, comparators, and switching mechanisms. In the case of limited number on sense, the demand with high resolution & credible sensitivity is choke point in technology. The 2-levels filter arithmetic is put forward in the paper, which is applied to reduce great the noise on sense channel. It is always stable, and offer higher performance for the case of limited number on sense.

articleTitle: Research on ideological and political education based on family & friendship in university
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper studies the application of family and friendship education carried out in scattered learning position. The role of teacher and communication are studied based on participant ideological and political education students in a family and friendship class. The result of study demonstrated the different effects of teacher's teaching effectiveness such as expending, rhetorical and provocative. Further, teach in family and friendship education class lacks communication often fails and proper system back-channel cues as a teaching result feedback. The study result also shows that there is balance lack between the students and teacher in the distribution of understand, eventually leading to interaction is in one-way. Normally, the students become an recipients in class reacting against lack feedback. Statement and question posed by teacher is designed to break the barriers through mediating technology. Also Both sides of teacher and student are frequently impaired by practice, misunderstand is described as a education space connected by the communication technology.

articleTitle: The dosimetry effect of setup errors for patients with esophageal carcinoma in IG-IMRT
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The study aims to measure the setup errors of patients with esophageal carcinoma during the treatment of three dimensional conformal radiotherapy (3DCRT). Through the simulation of the three dimensional treatment planning, evaluate the dosimetry effect of setup errors to GTV, CTV and normal tissues around in the actual treatment. From January 2007 to January 2008, 42 chosen patients with esophageal cancer were given 3DCRT. By applying the EPID, the setup errors were measured. Each patient would be examined six times during the treatment, with the frequency of once a week. The simulation of the setup errors can be achieved by moving the isocenter and then observe and analyze the dose distribution of GTV, CTV and normal tissues. There are three main results. The first one is that the systematic setup errors of the 42 patients, from leftward to rightward, was -2.31mm, and the random errors was 4.42mm, while form forward to backward, the systematic setup errors was -0.55mm, while the random errors was 4.35mm, and form upward to downward, the data were -0.16mm and 4.48mm, respectively. The second one is that the setup errors resulted in dose reduction of GTVD95 with 32cGy and CTVD95 with 88cGy. The last one is that the V20 of lung for PLAN1 and PLAN2 were 22.49±5.20% and 22.02±5.47% respectively. The average doses of heart for PLAN1 and PLAN2 were 2077.62±1292.75cGy and 2036.23±1295.86cGy. In the original plan, no patients whose maximum dose of spinal cord exceeded 4500cGy, while 18 cases (42.86%) in PLAN2 were more than 4500cGy, the maximum dose was 5503.90cGy. In the end, the conclusion is the setup errors lowered the level of dose distribution in the original plan so as to reduce the dose of GTV and CTV, while the doses of lung and heart did not change obviously, however, some patients whose maximum dose of spinal cord may exceeded 4500cGy.

articleTitle: Research on personalized service of basic data resources integration platform based on ontology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to establish a new mode of providing comprehensive personalized service for platform's users, this paper introduces ontology and web service discovery technology, proposes a new pattern of multi-level personalized service direct to the features of basic data resources integration platform, and then designs a user model based on ontology, personalized - service discovery framework and two types of personalization, including personalized service customized and personalized services recommended. This can enhance its semantic information and realize the sharing and reuse of cross-system user model and make the customize and recommend results not only contain the information but also include functional modules, which fully embody the user's preferences, and meet user demands better.

articleTitle: Research and application of plan recognition in Intelligent Tutoring System
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper introduces how to apply plan recognition technology to Intelligent Tutoring System (ITS). ITS can recognize the student's learning plan automatically, guide students to chooses teaching content and strategies according to the recognized plan. While much effort has been devoted to ITS, it can be shown the assumptions underlying that many current plan recognition approaches do not hold in ITS and it blocks the application of plan recognition in ITS. Actually, plan recognition is very useful and important in ITS. So the paper addresses how to recognize student's learning strategy based on the theory of Granularity Hierarchies. Furthermore, we discuss that the present approach is used to solve practical problems in ITS.

articleTitle: Application research of computer adapted color vision test in Chinese Medicine inspection skill training
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective To observe the color vision testing and training improves Chinese Medicine inspection diagnosis teaching effectiveness. Methods Those students who attended the course of Chinese Medicine diagnosis methods research in Beijing University of Chinese Medicine were selected to take part in this test. Farnsworth-Munsell 100 HUE Test system was used to evaluate the students' color discrimination ability. After the first test, students receive two-week training. And then Testing Error Score and different tone color vision ability was collected to analysis the students' color vision ability. Results After training, among all 98 tested students, there are 82 persons' (84.67%) level of color discrimination ability raised, 12 (12.26%) declined, 4 (4.08%) unchanged. The average TES of students score as good in the first test reduced from 10.55±5.63 to 7.23±8.36, within normal group reduced from 46.51±20.69 to 22.86±22.95, in poor group reduced from 122.13 ±26.21 to 46.63±34.43, the difference was statistically significant (p<0.05). Compared with other 3 groups, red-yellow hue color discrimination ability improvement is most significant (p<0.05). Conclusion This study provides the teaching of inspection diagnosis an objective assessment and training tools. By using FM100 Hue Test, the ability of medical students' color discrimination can be effectively improved.

articleTitle: Establishment of a non-invasive salivary diagnostic model for TCM syndrome differentiation in breast cancer based on SELDI and bioinformatics techniques
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective The salivary proteins of breast cancer patients of liver-qi stagnation syndrome and of liver-kidney yin deficiency syndrome were examined using surface-enhanced laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry (SELDI-TOF-MS), and specific protein markers were screened out to establish a salivary protein fingerprint model for distinguishing breast cancer liver-qi stagnation and liver-kidney yin deficiency. Methods The protein patterns of 47 salivary specimens (26 cases of liver-qi stagnation of breast cancer, 21 cases of liver-kidney yin deficiency of breast cancer) were examined with SELDI-TOF-MS to establish a TCM syndrome diagnosis model for breast cancer. Results 243 protein peaks were detected in the specimens, 33 of which showed significant difference between the two groups. The liver-qi stagnation syndrome and the liver-kidney yin deficiency syndrome of breast cancer could be correctly distinguished by the diagnostic model comprised of two proteins with M/Z of 8087.575 and 3378.142 Da, respectively; 25 out of the 26 cases of liver-qi stagnation syndrome was correctly diagnosed, and all the 21 cases of liver-kidney yin deficiency were correctly excluded; the sensitivity reached 96.15% (25/26) and the specificity was 80.95%(17/21). Conclusion The salivary protein fingerprint model for TCM syndrome differentiation established with SELDI-TOF-MS provided a highly specific, sensitive new method that is worth further study and application.

articleTitle: Analysis of digital library information services
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Digitization is the inevitable development trend of library under the network environment. It is very important to grasp the characteristics of digital library information service and solve the problems. The target-oriented and personalized development service can speed up the service construction of library information.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of the physical education course resources system theory
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The physical education course resources system is an open system composed of static and dynamic systems. By analyzing the physical education course resources as a system, we can learn more about the connotation and structure of the physical education course resources and the relationship between the various constituent elements of physical education resources, grasp the essence and law of the physical education course resources. In order to study the structure and function of the physical education course resources system to explain the relevant theory of the physical education course resources system, we try to objectively analyze various resources which may play a supportive and safeguarding role for the physical education course existing in the material world, spirit field and consciousness category, and comprehensively analyze and arrange the elements of physical education resources.

articleTitle: Development of remote controlled lab scale bioreactor using virtual instrument technology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: By using virtual instrument technology, a direct digital control bioreactor is developed, which is able to be remote controlled through internet. Mathematical model of the bioreaction system is developed, which is used in prediction of the unmeasured process variables and the model based process control.

articleTitle: Bank credit risk management early warning and decision-making based on BP neural networks
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Credit risk management, which is the basic of the credit application, is the most perfect embodiment in the bank credit application and asset supervision. The ultimate purpose of credit risk management is to ensure that credit fund is of safety, profitability and fluidity. At present, it is extremely important of commercial banks to set up an early bank risk warning system. The author who makes great effort on the credit risk and its reason, besides bringing in the western commercial banks experience of bank credit risk management, makes researches on credit risk in a microcosmic view. The author sets up early warning indicators for commercial bank credit risk, and carries out the warning for the credit risk in advance with the help of artificial neural networks. The experiment has proved that this method is objective and effective. So it can provide theoretical basis, which is more scientific and credible for detection and early warning about commercial bank credit risk.

articleTitle: SCENE admin: A component-based integrated management framework for web service platforms
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With web service platforms such as Web Service Container, BPEL Engine, Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) are more and more widely used, the management of these platforms become an important issue. The management information of these platforms is similar and the requirements for managing web service platforms are varied as more and more web service platforms appear. In this paper, a component-based approach is introduced for the implementation of the integrated management framework for web service platforms. The integrated environment offers a unified entrance which is convenient for administrator to access the management tools of the web service platforms. The overall system architecture, the basic service components, the fine grained web app services, integrated environment are explained in details. A practical implementation shows that our design is able to support extensible on-demand management service for web service platforms.

articleTitle: Identification of a Gordonia sp. strain producing carotenoids
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: A pigment-producing strain HBUT-Y was indentified by morphological characterization, physiological & biochemical taxonomy and molecular phylogeny, the carotenoids components in the strain were analyzed. It was found that similarity between the HBUT-Y and strains in genus Gordonia ranged from 95% to 99% through 16S rRNA sequence comparison. Substrate utilization data were provided by Biolog automated microbial identification system. combining with the result, HBUT-Y was preliminary indentified as a Gordonia sputi. Major pigment components in acetone extraction of HBUT-Y were assayed as carotenoids in detection of optical absorption in 452nm,477nm,507nm.

articleTitle: Teaching and learning pattern recognition using neural networks
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, we present a project oriented teaching and learning scheme that facilitates the students' capabilities of understanding, analyzing and solving the pattern recognition problems. In this scheme, a neural networks based face recognition project is developed for the educational purposes. The project consists of two components: a demonstration project which introduces the fundamental concepts of data preprocessing, feature extraction, neural network training and testing to the students; and a part of potential discussions for the lecture instructors to guide their students to conduct an in-depth study in the project. Upon successful participation and completion of the project, students will be able to apply the neural network principles in the potential pattern recognition applications.

articleTitle: A novel micromolecule glutathione peroxidase mimic
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Glutathione peroxidase is a mammalian selenoenzyme that catalyzes the reduction of hydroperoxides and play crucial roles in scavenging reactive oxygen species in living organisms. Native glutathione peroxidase have poor solubility and limited cellular accessibility. Morevoer, it is difficult to prepare using traditional recombinant DNA technology. Peptides with an Arg-Gly-Asp (RGD) sequence have shown to have a high affinity for cytomembrane. In the present study, a novel selenopeptide, Sec-RGD, was designed and synthesized. Moreover, its antioxidant was confirmed by cytological expeniments.
