Malformations and differentiation of cartilage were induced by foreign p204 and cbfa1 injection, and the top level of malformation rate was induced by p204&cbfa1 double injection. Moreover, the expression of three genes (osx, tcf7 and vent) involved in osteogenesis and dorsoventral patterning were significantly upregulated after injection. Similar with the malformation rate, the top expression level of the three genes is also caused by double injection. The results of acid-free double staining showed that endochondral ossification was more obviously affected by p204&cbfa1 injection compared with other injection groups. This study showed that p204 and cbfa1 have the synergistic effect on osteogenesis and dorsoventral patterning, not only in vitro, but also in zebrafish embryogenesis.

articleTitle: Teaching and learning in the environment of New Media—Opinion on the reform of innovative talents training model in universities
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: New Media develops rapidly in recent years and it has various modes of transmission. The paper introduces in the environment of New Media how the development of its transmission affects the traditional teaching and learning model in universities, and according to its characteristics, brings up the opinion of reforming innovative talents training model by the better use of its transmission technology.

articleTitle: Reviews on economic effects assessment of emerging technologies
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Emerging technologies, to a large extent, have become driver of economic development in a region and even a nation, so to grasp the economic impact of emerging technologies is of significant meaning. This paper set out from the connotation of emerging technologies, then discussed the economic effect of emerging technologies respectively from their evaluation content and evaluation methods. Based on review of economic effect assessment of emerging technologies from scholars both at home and abroad, finally the paper proposed the idea using “seismic approach” to evaluate economic effect of emerging technologies, and pointed out basic steps about “seismic approach”, which laid the foundation for the empirical analysis.

articleTitle: When students' self regulation of learning in peer group encounters novel knowledge at university
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Collaborating the perspectives of socialization and self regulation of learning in peer group, the research examines the practical mechanism of students' self regulation in learning at university. Individuals' self regulation in learning and the influence from the ambient of peer group were explored through the lens of regulation in different aspects of individuals' metacognition, which are monitoring and self-regulation. Based on specific background of course learning, representing students' transacting from pre-tertiary courses to professional degree courses, the findings of research showed that deficiency in knowledge at level of metacognition limited students' abilities of self regulation in learning when facing with novel and high level knowledge. It might be the blind spot of present higher education and its impaction might be extending and sprawling.

articleTitle: Anxiety disorders: Reporting quality with a CONSORT-and-STRICTA based instrument
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective The OCSI system was applied to evaluate the quality of domestic and overseas randomized controlled trials(RCTs) of acupuncture treatment for anxiety disorders. Method: RCTs involving acupuncture for anxiety disorders were identified from CBM, VIP, WANFANG Database, CNKI, PubMed, EMbase, and The Cochrane Library‥ All retrieval cut-off time was April 1, 2011, and meanwhile, the manual retrieval from Guangzhou University of traditional Chinese medicine library database was processed. report quality evaluation of the those included literature will be conducted with OCSI (Oregon CONSORT STRICTA Instrument) This will be a comparative study according to the year when the literatures were published and the score of each entry. Result 58 papers have been included. Between 1994 and 2011, the acupuncture treatment of anxiety disorder RCT report has been significantly increased, and the quality has been improved gradually. (P<0.001) However, there are 16 items whose mean scores <1.0 points (No 5,9,11,12,13,14,15,16,17, 18,19,21,24,25,26,27). Those 16 items account for 59.3% of the total number [95%CI (40.72%∼77.67%)]. Meanwhile, operator's background, diversity of result analysis method, the implementation methods of random sequence, allocation concealment, distribution sequences, setting blinding and evaluation the success of blinding implementation, the flow of participants through each stage quantitatively described and reasons of protocol deviations were relatively poorer. Conclusion The quality of those papers in acupuncture treatment for anxiety disorder research is generally low at present, In the future, application of international recognized CONSORT statement and STRICTA standard to regularize acupuncture clinical trials is recommended.

articleTitle: Effects of lipopolysaccharide and dexamethasone on the biological characteristics of rats alveolar macrophage
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Alveolar macrophages(AMs) play a central role in lung inflammation and acute lung injury, but also participate actively in the resolution of inflammation after activation. Macrophages (Mφ) represent a dynamic cell population that develops and operates within a changing microenvironment. However, it is not known how the biological characteristic of AM stimulates by lipopolysaccharide (LPS) or desamethasone (DEX) and the relationship between AM and inflammation. In this study, we first observed the morphology in AM isolated from rats differed according to the molecule used. We found that LPS-stimulated AM induced anti-apoptosis and had pro-inflammatory effects; dexamethasone induced AM apoptosis and had anti-inflammatory effects. These results suggested that a balance in macrophage activation, being either stimulated by LPS) or DEX, would be important to participate sequentially in both the induction and the resolution of inflammation. These findings may provide new insight into the lung inflammatory process as well as new fields of investigation for immunotherapy in the fields of acute lung injury/ acute respiratory distress syndrome.

articleTitle: Supplementation with glucose in PZM-3 medium improve the in vitro development of porcine transgenic cloned embryos
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The efficiency of producing porcine transgenic cloned embryos is still low due to lower developmental competence compared to in vivo-fertilized/cultured embryos. This phenomenon may correlates with poor culture condition. Energy substrate in culture medium play an important role in optimizing culture condition. This study pertain to investigate the effect of replacing pyruvate and lactate with glucose in PZM-3 medium at the rest part culture period on porcine embryonic development after SCNT. Porcine adult fibroblasts cells were transfected with pEGFP-C1 vector. Then transfected cells were used as donor cells for producing re-constructed embryos. Results have shown that supplement of glucose up to 5mM concentration in PZM-3 at the rest part of culture period improved the development of transgenic cloned embryos. Moreover, supplement of glucose(5mM) as energy substrate in PZM-3 at 48h of culture was optimal time. However, with regard to the percentage of EGFP-positive blastocyst, there was no significant difference between treatments. In conclusion, replacing pyruvate and lactate with glucose in PZM-3 medium at the rest part of culture period was beneficial to the development of transgenic cloned embryos and had no effect on transgene expression.

articleTitle: Investigation on the interaction between 3, 5-dihydroxytoluene and bovine serum albumin by fluorescence spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The interaction between 3, 5-dihydroxytoluene and bovine serum albumin (BSA) had been investigated by fluorescence spectroscopy. By the analysis of fluorescence spectrum and fluorescence intensity, it was observed that the 3, 5-dihydroxytoluene had a strong ability to quench the intrinsic fluorescence of BSA through a static quenching procedure. The binding constant and the number of binding sites were determined at 298 K based on fluorescence quenching results. The thermodynamic parameters such as enthalpy change (ΔH), entropy change (ΔS) and Gibbs free-energy change (ΔG) for the reactions were also calculated according to the thermodynamic equations. The negative ΔH and ΔS values in case of 3, 5-dihydroxytoluene-BSA complexes showed that van der Waals interactions and hydrogen bonds might play a major role in the binding of 3, 5-dihydroxytoluene to BSA. The distance, r, between donor (BSA) and acceptor (3, 5-dihydroxytoluene) was obtained according to the Förster's theory of non-radiation energy transfer. The experimental results of synchronous fluorescence spectroscopy showed that the binding of 3, 5-dihydroxytoluene to BSA induced conformational changes in BSA.

articleTitle: The mental accounting and moderating role of habit in usage of online social media: Implications for higher education
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This study proposes a mental accounting and habit model of online social media (OSM) usage to examine the moderating effect of habit and distinct impact of OSM attributes on the value assessment and behavioral choices of the technology. The model was validated using data from a field survey of online social networking services (OSNS). This study contributes to information systems (IS) research, and has practical implications for practitioners and administrators of higher education.

articleTitle: Research on the architecture of Open Education based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: For the “information island” in the information processing, in this paper, we present “Cloud Education”, a information architecture based on cloud computing in Open Education. “Cloud Education” uses four sublayers, physical hardware layer, virtualization layer, middleware layer of education and the application interface layer to allow service instances to be placed anywhere in the sublayers. We described the communication process of the sublayers with a formal language CSP (Communicating Sequential Processes), and discussed the key technologies in this model. At last, we evaluate the merits of the model through simulation experiment, and proved the model is flexibility and expansibility. As a result, we can deploy the “Cloud Education” to the Open Education.

articleTitle: Research of index technology for topic search engine
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The index technology is a important research field for topic search engine. We put forward a efficient index file model for Chinese HTML pages. The double-byte inverted index and virtual memory drives technology ensure the system response time in the design goal. The test presents that the model has a good expansibility and stability and the system still less than 1 second with the increasing of data.

articleTitle: An experience-computer-based university course arrangement system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Course arrangement is an important part of educational administration in university. With the improvement in information system construction and the development in education reform, it brings up higher request for course arrangement. This paper proposed an intelligent course arrangement system based on experience-computer, which solves the problem by designing appropriate time pattern and priority model, as well as using the heuristic algorithm, backtracking algorithm and tabu search algorithm. It is proven that the system embodies the concept of education management reform, and improves the efficiency of course arrangement in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Improve engineering drawing teaching by combining modern methods and traditional methods
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the development of technology, computer multimedia assistant teaching methods are applied widely and have unexampled advantages compared to the traditional method. Teacher should know the characteristics of different teaching methods and combine the modern methods with the traditional one reasonably to do the teaching of Engineering Drawing. Teacher can not only give play to teach but also inspire student to study hard, so as to obtain good teaching effect.

articleTitle: Research on the characteristics and education of ideal and belief for the post-90s university students
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Applying self-made questionnaires to 956 university students from five universities and colleges in Zhengzhou, Henan, China, the survey is made to gauge the characteristic features of their ideals and belief. The result shows that, to some extent, they entertain a sense of responsibility politically and socially, yet more utility in their participation motives. They take a positive and confident approach towards life, but too much go in for material comforts. They own various and feasible professional ideals and belief, but are poor in anti-frustration. They have a strong sense of moral identity, but weak awareness to put it in practice. Having finished a systematic analysis of the problems related, I put forward some constructive suggestions on the education of ideals and belief, so that university students in higher education institutions can benefit in a scientific and effective way.

articleTitle: Using a web-based system to explore peer, self, and tutor assessment in problem-based learning tutorials
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: The purpose of this study was to explore self-, peer-, and tutor assessment of performance in tutorials among medical students in a problem-based learning curriculum. Methods: 117 students enrolled in the third year of the Doctor of Medicine Program at Fudan University were recruited to participate in a study of self, peer, and tutor assessment. Both quantitative and qualitative data were collected from the assessment of PBL performance within the tutorial setting. Results: The students scored themselves and peer higher than their tutor. The Bland Altman plots showed both self and peer scores agreed well with tutor scores. However, the correlation between self and tutor scores, between peer-averaged and tutor scores, both showed no statistical significance. Conclusion: Self and peer assessment showed poor accuracy but they had the potential to enhance students' self- awareness, reflection ability, and their ability to evaluate.

articleTitle: Application and research of Bluetooth technology in the development of the portable device for the evaluation of myodynamia
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The portable device for the evaluation of muscle strength based on Bluetooth technology is developed in this research, which consists of muscle strength sensor, MSP430F149 microcontroller system, Bluetooth communication module and PC. The muscle strength of the limbs and other different parts of trunk in human body can be measured and evaluated within 0~500N. Bluetooth communication module can realize data transmission from muscle strength sensor to PC within 10m. This device has the merit of low power, simple architecture, easy to operate, etc., which can provide quantitative analysis in the rehabilitation of muscle function in clinic.

articleTitle: The Post-Trauma Mobile Service platform and its evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The fast developing mobile technology has been explored by a few scientists including psychologists in their research. Post-Trauma Mobile Service platform (PTMS) is a platform based on mobile phone, which delivers psychotherapy and related information. Users could evaluate their psychological status, get feedback and customize psychotherapy intervention materials as soon as their psychological test finished. The second part of this article is to evaluate PTMS in effectiveness, usability, feasibility and willingness to use PTMS. The descriptive analysis shows that most users enjoy using PTMS, consider it feasible and show great willingness to use in the future. It is suggested by one-way ANOVA analysis that compared with other users, physical disabled users think that PTMS is more effective and feasible, which may implicate that PTMS, as an adjunct of professional psychotherapy, should be offered to those who need psychological service.

articleTitle: Group size and habitat selection of Oriental skylark(Alauda gulgula)in summer and autumn at Changde Taohuayuan Airport of Hunan Province
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: As one of the resident birds in all of arports in Hunan Province, Oriental skylark (Alauda gulgula) behaves more frequent activities in summer and autumn especially, which impact on the safe operation of aircrafts greatly. To guide the work of bird protection around the airport, a fundamental study about the aggregative behaviors and habitat selections of oriental skylark was conducted from July, 2008 to October, 2009 at Changde Taohuayuan Airport, Hunan Province. According to the environment in the flight area, the categories and heights of vegetation picked out as two basic ecological factors for studying. The results showed that the clustering frequencies in summer and autumn were greatest significant (P<0.01), and there were significant differences between individuals from different group sizes (P<0.05). Oriental skylark preferred to shelter in these brush woods which were 10∼20 cm in height and of 3∼10 kinds of plants in summer; while in autumn they would prefer those which were below 20 cm in height and of 2∼12 kinds of plants. There was no significant difference about the proportion of individuals in different heights of brush woods in summer and autumn. Mann-Whitnly Z=0.218, P=0.827>0.05, Kolmogorov-Smirnov Z=0.408, P=0.996>0.05. Finally, according to the aggregative behaviors and habitat selections of Oriental skylark, some special measures of bird protection were put forward at the airport.

articleTitle: An implementation of a structured and highly engaging learning environment on educational games for elementary education
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Using the previous studies on educational game development and coercive learning as our basis, the goal of our project is to be able to develop video games for mobile handheld devices that will be used as educational tools for the topics in the Grade 6 Science Curriculum. The game that we developed tackled Food Chains and Food Webs as topics which are parts of Grade 6 Science Curriculum. The game was developed for the Apple iPod Touch and used a free and open-source game engine, Cocos2D. By identifying the key game elements that make a video game compelling, we were able to strive for a goal of establishing balance between learning and gaming. Lastly, assessment of the games on the teachers' and the students' perspective was conducted to investigate the effectiveness of the games that were created. Based on the results, we can conclude that with slight modifications the game can be used to supplement learning in Grade 6 students.

articleTitle: A real-time tele-health monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper discusses a real-time tele-health monitoring system for family health care. The overall framework of system consists of three parts: the acquisition equipments of real-time physiological data, server-side and browser client. The system is mainly used for obtaining physiological data which are at the remote. Doctors diagnose the health status of users through tracking and monitoring physiological data. According to the current status of users, Doctors send some reminders and notes. When an emergency occurs, Doctors can take action quickly. The operating environment of system is easy to build and it can also work in mobile environments such as in ambulances with mobile network support. The system can also work in mobile environments such as in ambulances with mobile network support. It makes healthcare more portable and enhances the rescue reaction efficiency in emergency situations.

articleTitle: Application of phage-indicator model in evaluation of antiviral drugs in vitro
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: A novel method which evaluates antiviral drugs in vitro by phage-indicator model was developed. The phage inactivation experiments were carried out with antiviral drugs of Shuanghuanglian (SHL), Ribavirin and Monoammonium Glycyrrizinate (MG). Firstly, the toxicity of three drugs to the indicator (E. coli) was determined to get rid of interference of the model system. The results indicated that SHL and Ribavirin had toxicity to the indicator, which was relative to their doses. The drug act of the three drugs was detected in the model. The data demonstrated that the phage survival was significantly inhibited by SHL and Ribavirin. After the interaction of the drugs and phage for 20 h, the inhibition rate of SHL and Ribavirin to phage survival reached the maximum of 89.69% and 47.50%, respectively, while MG had not any inhibition to phage. Based on these experimental results, evaluation of antiviral drug in vitro by means of the phageindicator model is feasible, practicable, and suitable for screening of antiviral drugs, especially for those from a large number of natural products isolated.

articleTitle: Study on the emergency mechanism of Chinese basic medical insurance system and its management informatization
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In the past few years, public health emergencies are frequent in China. During the processing procedure, it not only exposed the deep level problems of public health system, but also highlighted a lot of hidden troubles in emergency management of basic medical insurance system. This article analyzes the problems of China's basic medical insurance system, and expounds the impact from public health emergencies. Then, according to the problems of public health information system, the article offers measurements for establishing emergency mechanism of public health emergencies in medical insurance, and setting up the information platform. It offers a kind of thinking in solving blind spots of medical insurance during dealing with public health emergencies. In addition, it also facilitates the medical rescue work going along rapidly, efficiently and orderly. The casualty and health hazard will be reduced to the minimum. Therefore, the Social stability is maintained.

articleTitle: Study on S180 and H22 Tumor suppressor and inducing apoptosis on tumor-bearing mice by ground beetle's fibrinolytic Protein
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Ground beetle's fibrinolytic Protein was researched on its S180 and H22 Tumor suppressor and inducing apoptosis on tumor-bearing mice. Methods: 100 mice were randomly divided into S180 group and H22 group, and the right armpit of each mouse was injected 0.2ml tumor cell suspension subcutaneously. It contains five sections, named Model group, Cyclophosphamide group (20mg/kg), High concentration group (2.90mg/kg), median concentration group (1.45mg/kg), Low concentration group (0.73mg/kg). 10 mice in each group were dose by hypodermic injection on the next day after inoculation, and administered once a day. After 8 days, mice were killed, and inhibition rate were calculate though the solid tumor in their armpits. Also the apoptosis rate and the expression of caspase-3 were determination. The results show that ground beetle's fibrinolytic protein had a certain anti-tumor effect on S180 and H22 solid tumors, also it could lead to apoptosis and caspase-3 expression increased.

articleTitle: A study on college students' awareness of learning strategy in cloze test with SPSS
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In the last decades, many studies have been conducted on learning strategy, but seldom focus on learning strategy awareness. In fact, a good understanding of strategies can discover problems in learning, thus effective strategy use could be put forward to improve learning efficiency. The main concern of this study is to investigate whether strategy awareness differences lie between high group and low group and between genders. A questionnaire is used to measure the subjects' cognitive and metacognitive strategy awareness in taking a multiple cloze test. All the raw data are analyzed by using the SPSS, Version 12.0. The results indicate that high group employs more metacognitive and cognitive strategies than low group does. Males employ more planning strategy, while female participants are superior to males in terms of monitoring and evaluating strategies.

articleTitle: Application of flash on meridians and collaterals popular science education
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Health education is not only a great social systems engineering that can spread health-care knowledge and developing healthy behaviors and stimulate the body, but also an important engineering of the people's livelihood that concerns people's life quality level. In this paper we first analyze the current situation and existing problems of medical popular science animation in our Country, then advance a new method that using Flash to make meridians and collaterals into animation which can popularize health knowledge in the way of stories. Thirdly we elaborate the working process of The secret of meridians and collaterals, which, to some extend, combine interest with infotainment that improves the health attainments of audience unconsciously.

articleTitle: Social value orientation and cooperative behavior in prisoner dilemma
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This study explored the influence of social value orientation on cooperative behavior. The cooperative behavior of 14-year-old children and adults was measured in prisoner dilemma. Results showed that prosocial adults had higher expectation on others' cooperative behavior. Social value orientation does influence people's cooperative behavior.

articleTitle: Physical health status of faculty in Jiangsu University
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Aim: This study aims to examine the physical health status of faculty in Jiangsu University. Methods: A sample of 1,400 faculties were randomly selected from the physical examination system in Jiangsu University, and 1,177 persons who participated in the physical examination actively in them were statistically analyzed. Results: There are 848 people who have abnormal physical examination indicator, the overall abnormal physical examination rate is 72.05%; the top three abnormal rates of physical indicators are Type-B ultrasonic (32.46%), Lipid (26.34%), Electrocardiogram (25.40%).Conclusion: It is necessary to carry out various health management activities actively such as physical examination, health education and health guidance, prevent and control diseases, improve the quality of health status of faculty in Jiangsu University.

articleTitle: Dot immunogold filtration assay for rapid detection of Sudan I residue in chili powder
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: A method of Dot immunogold filtration assay for rapid detection of Sudan I residue in food was developed. Sudan I derivate-gelatin immunogen has been synthesized using the mixed anhydride method. Polyclonal antibodies were raised against the immunogen in rabbits. The purified antibody was immobilised on the nitrocellulose membrane as the test reagent. When the sample was added into the test device, the possible Sudan I in samples and the gold-labeled Sudan I-BSA conjugate which was added subsequently into the test device will competitively capture the immobilised antibody. The more Sudan I present in the samples, the more effective competition reaction with gold-labeled Sudan I-BSA occurred. A visible red dot shows a negative result in the read-out zone, and vice versa. Results showed that the detection limit was 0.8 μg/mL in chili powder. Quantitative analysis of Sudan I could be achieved between 0.2 μg/mL and 1.0 μg/mL. Compared with HPLC methods, the results showed a good correlation with a square of correlation coefficient of 0.941. Low cross-reactivity was found among other Sudan dyes. The analysis could be completed in shorter time, suitable for rapid detect Sudan I residue in food and preliminary screening detections for abundant samples.

articleTitle: Using Simio for wartime casualty treatment simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper focuses on the use of a discrete simulation tool ( Simio ) to explore simulation of casualty treatment in wartime. Through the use of Simio simulation platform, visual simulation model of casualty treatment was developed, based on analysis of the casualty treatment task and process in wartime. Then, a personnel allocation in an operating room was tested using the model developed by simulation experiment. The casualty treatment simulation can help more accurately model the flow and medical treatment of wartime casualties in treatment network, and simulation model developed can support medical resources estimation and test resources allocation.

articleTitle: A new ground control point image-chip automatic matching method for remote sensing image location processing
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Get access to ground control points(GCPs) by ground control point image-chip matching is the key to automated precise geometric correction processing which is a great improvement compared to artificial reference map or the GPS method. The key to obtain GCPs is the correct matching between GCP image chips and images to be corrected. The existing gray-scale based normalized correlation and edge-based normalized matching algorithms are in-depth studied, and a method that combined normalized correlation and Renyi entropy mutual information multi-criteria image matching is proposed. Experiments show that the new method did well on matching homologous and heterologous images and will be a good support for GCP quick acquisition and automated precise geometric correction processing.

articleTitle: Optimal management of educational resources design based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The spatial design of experiment and information subset had been studied by correlated random sequence sampling. The problems in many applied region had been found, such as statistical geology, sampling sequence, and environmental statistics. In all applications, maximum sampling sequence can be selected and different location and times. In maximum sampling sequence design, the feasible design program would be taken when the design domain and time are discrete from the design goal and expected result. The main problem is how to solve the maximum sampling sequence design idea. This is the algorithm GA sequence theory problem. In order to apply the GA design in computer experiments, in many cases, the design space is not possible to calculate accurately. In order to improve the efficient experiment of sampling sequence, the GA algorithm is developed to take advantage of Robustness power of sequence algorithm. The test results show that design idea and construction are very efficient for solving the mistake.

articleTitle: Exploitation of minimum risk system based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The basic function of a neural system is to intelligent learning from specific examples known as neurons. It has great pattern adaptive capability that may be used to judge between old model and well model. Neural systems have many characteristics such as autonomous, uniqueness, recognition of foreigners, noise tolerance, and distributed detection. Inspired by neural network system, Artificial Neural Network has emerged during the last decade. It is incited by many researchers to build, study, and design neural-based models for a variety of application regions. Artificial neural system can be defined as adaptive model that is inspired by neural network, observed neural functions, mechanisms and principles. Association rule mining is one of well researched and the most important techniques of datum mining. The purpose of association rules is to refine interesting correlations, associations, frequent patterns, or casual constructions in sets of aims in other datum repositories or the transaction databases. Association rule is widely used in various regions such as telecommunication network, inventory control, intelligent decision, risk management and market analysis etc. Artificial Neural Network is the most widely used algorithm for mining the association rules. In this paper, Artificial Neural Network is studied and optimized based on classification system. The performance of the ANN based on classification system is evaluated by varying number of generations and computing accuracy at different factors. Three standard datum had been used to computer the accuracy. The test result shows that the system can give highest accuracy more than o.4.

articleTitle: Explore ways of using computer technology to construct test datebase of “Pedagogy” course
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Using computers to construct test database is necessary for realizing educational modernization, separating teaching from testing and maximizing institutional efficiency. It has positive effects on course construction. “Pedagogy” is a public basic course for Normal University students. To ensure the test database to be scientific, standardization is highlighted during the process of editing.

articleTitle: Research on watermark of electronic examination paper
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Electronic examination paper (EEP) should be protected in copyright and tamper-resistant in its lifetime. A security solution based on watermark for this problem is given in this paper. Two kinds of watermark are designed: copyright watermark and tamper-resistant watermark. Copyright watermark is an ID of the examination, which is consists of proposition, time of exam, exam taker, object of examination, etc.. Tamper-resistant watermark is produced in two methods. One is constructed by embedding the abstract information into the paper by changing the title line format. Another is based in attribution of the paper such as words, characters, paragraphs, etc.. Simulated attacks detections show that the copyright watermark is robust and tamper-resistant watermark can detect the modification on examination paper caused by active attacks.

articleTitle: Research on the system construction of the continuing education for the physical education teacher
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to train excellent physical education teachers, promote the reform of school physical education and speed up to train sports talents at all levels, we research and analyze the status and development of teacher continuing education, construct the theoretical system framework of the teacher continuing education in the physical education institutes based on the theoretical analysis, exploration, and analyzing the major factor of teacher continuing education, combining the current status of the continuing education in physical education institutes to sketched out the basic framework for the continuing education in physical education institutes, thus ensure the systematic development of the continuing education in physical education institutes.

articleTitle: Exploration and practice of practice teaching system based on communication engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the development of the times, information technologies in teaching play an increasingly important role. According to the social needs of IT talent, cultivating the innovation talents, practice teaching system based on communication engineering is proposed, including change the teaching ideas, update teaching content, reform the evaluation mechanism and training of teachers. Introduce advanced IT education philosophy, proposed and implemented the “three levels” of the practice teaching platform to meet requirements of enterprise.

articleTitle: Optimization of medium components for low-temperature-active phytase production by Kurthia CZC0806 using response surface methodology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Response surface methodology (RSM) was taken to enhance the production of low-temperature-active phytase from the strain Kurthia CZC0806 which was isolated from the Yellow Sea in China. The Plackett-Burman and Box-Behnken design were applied to optimize the fermentation medium components of the strain. Peptone, saccharose and NaCl were selected as the most significant factors, based on the Plackett-Burman design. The Box-Behnken was designed for these three factors. The results were analyzed by using the Minitabl5.0 soft. The optimal medium is: Peptone, saccharose and NaCl (at 20°C, initial pH 7.0). In the optimal medium conditions, the activity of the enzyme is 103.11 U/mL.

articleTitle: The Training Teaching Management Informatization study and system realization based on web service
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The paper took the training teaching management of the surveying and mapping profession as a studying example to realize the training teaching management informatization. Based on Internet and web service technique, the paper proposed the five-layer system structure, and constructed the “Mapping Training Teaching Management Information System”. The realization and utilization of the system in practical provides powerful technology support for the training teaching management informatization. And it also provides useful experiences for the realization of the efficient training teaching management informatization.

articleTitle: Alcohol detection in translucent package using wavelet filtration by Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, by using a custom noise reduction method process the Raman spectra of alcohol, compared to wavelet noise reduction method in MATLAB, the Raman spectra of alcohol that processed by former is better, due to the peaks of alcohol composition is clearer and easier to distinguish. In addition, this method can remove the fluorescent background and interference of scattering light, so as to providing great convenience for rapid and non-destructive testing on alcohol by using Raman spectra.

articleTitle: Purification and functional characterization of two thrombosis-related molecules: von Willebrand Factor and ADAMTS-13
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: von Willebrand Factor (vWF) is secreted as the ultra-large (UL) multimeric glycoprotein by endothelial cells and megakaryocytes. It can be cleaved into small multimers by metalloprotease ADAMTS-13 following its secretion. As a member of a disintegrin and metalloproteinase with thrombospondin family, ADAMTS-13 plays a crucial role in thrombosis regulation. Many studies have revealed that unsuccessful cleavage of UL-vWF by ADAMTS-13 induced thrombosis. Here, we have purified A domain, which is the most important activity unit of vWF, and the full-length ADAMTS-13. Results of SDS-PAGE and Western blot confirmed two purified proteins have correct molecular weights. Flow cytometry analysis showed that the microspheres were functionalized via coating purified ADAMTS-13 on their surfaces. Using binding assay, microspheres coated with ADAMTS-13 can adhere on petri dishes coated with immobilized vWF A1A2A3 under static conditions, which were resulted from the binding between ADAMTS-13 and vWF A1A2A3. These results demonstrated purified ADAMTS-13 and vWF A1A2A3 have functional activities and can be used as an important tool for exploring the mechanism of interaction between vWF A1A2A3 and ADAMTS-13 in further studies for thrombosis regulations.

articleTitle: Lung cancer diagnosis based on serum autofluorescence
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Laser-induced fluorescence spectroscopy is a widely-used medicinal spectral technique that has been used on the diagnosis of tissues and cells. In this paper, we measured the auto-fluorescence of serum of lung cancer patients and healthy people using the technique of laser-induced fluorescence spectroscopy. Principal component analysis and discriminant analysis were used to analyze the data of fluorescence spectra, and an accuracy rate of 84% was obtained. Our preliminary research proved the possibility of using auto-fluorescence of serum for the diagnosis of lung cancer.

articleTitle: Structure of insect community of different habitats in Taihu wetland near Suzhou
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to discuss the insect community structure and changing regularity in Taihu wetland near Suzhou, the community characteristics of insects in four typical habitats (the wetland park, desolated beaches, phragmites australis stand and artificial forest) were thoroughly investigated. The results showed that there were 156 species of insect belonging to 11 orders, 86 families and the species - abundance of insects in four typical habitats fitted a log-normal model. Species diversity index (H'), species richness (ln S) and probability of interspecific encounter (PIE) in the wetland park were the largest, in desolated beaches were the second, in phragmites australis stand were the third and in artificial forest were the least. But evenness(E) in phragmites australis stand was the largest, in desolated beaches was the second, in the wetland park was the third and in artificial forest was the least. Community similarity just showed that the artificial forest and phragmites australis stand were similar.

articleTitle: The analysis and strategies of the influence factors of Network entertainment for university students
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: At the present, Network entertainments has become to be a most common entertainment carrier, has being gotten more and more university students' like. These network entertainment activities can be pleasurable, rich amateur life. But if the control is bad, excessive and bad network entertainment will bring a lot of negative effects for college students, such as killing the will, the eccentric, influence interpersonal relations influence. In order to solve these problems, this article from the state, society, universities, education workers, family and other view of the strategies to thoroughly solve the network negative effect of the college students' entertainment.

articleTitle: The study on the instruction mode of extensive reading in the web-based environment
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: As a rudimental English course, extensive reading course aims at providing sufficient language sources in a simulated environment. With the help of Internet and multi-media technology, the environment can be improved on a large scale. Diversified information can be displayed in various forms. The language input and output can be realized more smoothly. The validity of second language acquisition can be improved significantly. The learners' cognitive structures can be coordinated. The instruction mode of extensive reading course can be optimized in all perspectives.

articleTitle: Development of a monoclonal antibody that is specific for the Rabies virus phosphoprotein
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To develop a monoclonal antibodies against Rabies virus phosphoprotein (P), which has conserved domains, and such regions are potentially interesting targets for the diagnosis. Methodes: In the study, a rabies virus p gene coding for the rabies virus phosphoprotein was amplified by PCR and cloned into the expression vector pET32a (+). The recombinant protein was expressed in Escherichia coli, purified with a HisTrap FF crude prepacked column and used to produce mouse monoclonal antibodies (Mabs). The anti-P Mabs were purified and their specificity was tested by indirect ELISA. One specific Mab was further tested by Western blotting against recombinant P and immunofluorescence analysis on cell monolayers infected with rabies virus. Results: The recombinant viral phosphoprotein was successfully expressed as a 53.8 kDa fusion protein which corresponded to the whole protein of the rabies virus. Of the Mabs that were generated, one (4B5) was shown to be highly specific, and could be used to detect recombinant P and native P in the whole virus. Conclusion: The use of a P protein obtained from heterologous expression in E. coli allowed the development of a Mab that interacted specifically with the P protein. This Mab should be useful for future studies with the rabies virus.

articleTitle: A mobile digital rights management application System Based on agent technology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile communication, portable devices such as cell phone and tablet computer have been more and more widely used. Traditional publishers have come to realize the rising business value of mobile digital publishing. However, convenient reading and communication pattern brings not only the benefits but also some disadvantages. Rights protection of the digital publications is one of the most important problems. The OMA DRM system is a popular solution to establish digital rights management, but it is designed for desktop computer network from the beginning. Problems may uncover when it is used in mobile network. In this paper, we introduced a mobile digital rights management application system based on agent technology which made some improvement for mobile network environment.

articleTitle: Peer relations and learning in digital games
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: By analyzing two cases, one from China, another happened in United States, to illustrate how peer relations impact children's cognition and behavior. Then from a new perspective of the interaction dimension of learning, to explicate the role of identity which directly influences children's cognition and behavior in digital games. At last, we present an internal relation between children, peer relations, and learning in digital games.

articleTitle: Genetic diversity of Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lini by inter simple sequence repeat (ISSR)
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The genetic diversity in Fusarium oxysporum f . sp. lini from three natural populations (from Hebei, Ningxia and Inner Mongolia) was investigated by inter simple sequence repeat(ISSR). A total of 48 samples from 3 provinces were amplified using selected 10 primers. The band amplified by each primer ranged from 21 to 44, with the molecular weight between 250 and 5,000 bp. In total 316 bands were observed, 314 were polymorphic (99.37%). Nei's gene diversity (H) ranged from 0.0029 to 0.1994, and Shannon's information index (I) ranged from 0.0478 to 0.1809. Genetic diversity was greater within Ningxia populations (H = 0.1205, I = 0.1861). Unweighted pair-group mean analysis (UPGMA) indicated that clustering of Fusarium oxysporum f . sp. lini individuals mainly relates to their populations and geographic distances separating those populations. Genetic differentiation was indicated by ISSR analysis.

articleTitle: The value of echocardiographic diagnosis and pros and cons of steroids treatment in Kawasaki disease
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Echocardiography and coronary angiography is mainly used for the diagnosis of cardiovascular disease, we mainly evaluate the value of two-dimensional echocardiography (2D echo) in Kawasaki disease (KD). Steroids role in the primary treatment of KD is controversial. Our aim is to conduct a study to ascertain whether the addition of steroids to intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) for the treatment of KD should be administrated and might improve clinical outcomes. The medical record of total 553 patients with KD hospitalized in Jilin province were reviewed and analyzed. The results showed that all patients with KD were examined by 2D echo. 350 patients (63.3%) were found to exist coronary arterial lesions. 80 patients that did not occurred coronary arterial lesions (CAL) before administrated of steroids, 64 of them occurred CAL. In conclusion, echocardiography is the primary means in the diagnosis of CAL with KD. Steroids plus IVIG in primary therapy of KD can relieve symptoms quickly and reduce the re-application of IVIG, but patients treated with steroids had a possible heightened risk of contracting CAL.

articleTitle: Characteristics of the relation between diseases and acupuncture points in human body
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the characteristics of an acupoint-disease network by using complex networks theory. Firstly, we build an acupoint-disease network using the data from traditional Chinese medicine acupuncture books, and draw the diagram of the acupoint-disease network. Secondly, we make a projection from the acupoint-disease network to a disease-based acupoint network and an acupoint-based disease network respectively. And the static characteristics of these two networks, which include clustering coefficient, average path length and small-world character etc, are analyzed. Finally, we compare the analyzed results above with the traditional Chinese medicine theory, which indicates that the results totally conform to traditional Chinese medicine theory.

articleTitle: A multi-protocol network log clustering method based on grid
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: To deal with large scale network log and provide brief data sources for the later log analysis, the thesis propose a multi-protocol network log clustering method based on grid, which plot every log into data grid and first clustering in the grid,then According to similarity judgment, make the initial cluster secondary clustering, finally output clustered log, some sparse data and outlier data. Experiment result shows that the method can effectively compress log storage, reduce the time complexity, deal with actual dynamic data and realize incremental clustering.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of type selection of ambulance helicopter
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The method of computer simulation is applied to the study on the type selection of ambulance helicopter(AH). Based on the working flow of medical evacuation, the concept model and its simulation model are built to observe the patient flow. Tactical and technical indexes of ambulance helicopter, for example, airspeed and number of patients, are investigated through the output results such as mean evacuation waiting time. Therefore, it can lay a foundation on the type selection of AH. The result shows that the type holding more than 10 litter patients is preferred model and the aimed type is mi-171.

articleTitle: Computer web aided moral education
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In recent years, there were a lot of malignant event reports about the university student against the law. Therefore, moral education is of most importance. Moral education courses should be combined with the life. Moral education through the computer network technology can improve the teaching effect. This relies on the construction quality of the computer aided teaching system.

articleTitle: Foreground segmentation of binocular video based on multiple cues
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper proposes an automatic foreground segmentation algorithm. We develop an energy function that is composed of disparity, color and contrast cues to extract the foreground object accurately. Disparity is calculated to contribute the energy function with simple and effective methods. Background color model is constructed based on Gmms algorithm. Continuity characteristic is used to get the contrast cue. A binary label is assigned to each pixel by minimizing the designed energy function. A boundary smooth filter in frequency domain is presented in order to paste the foreground object into the virtual background seamlessly. Experimental results demonstrated that our segmentation algorithm based on multiple cues is efficient.

articleTitle: Manufacturing resource modeling and management based on blade manufacturing process
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, the blade process manufacturing resource management system is developed according to demand for a blade manufacturing. E-R model of the blade process manufacturing resource is proposed by analyzing the blade manufacturing process. On this basis to build the process manufacturing resource management system architecture and analyze how the system is achieved.

articleTitle: Investigation of the implementation of hospital knowledge management in China
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective To find out the level of understanding of hospital staff concerning knowledge management, in order to provide a basis for the implementation of knowledge management in hospitals. Method A questionnaire designed to assess understanding of the implementation state of hospital knowledge management. Participants were 411 management personnel from different grade hospitals nationwide chosen to take part in the questionnaire. Result The overall understanding of hospital staff about hospital knowledge management is very low. The understanding of staff from different grades of hospitals is different (P < 0.05, P < 0.01). There are also differences between employees of different gender, different age, different educational background, different professional titles and specialized fields (P < 0.05, P < 0.01). However, all of them are keen to develop knowledge management across hospitals. Conclusion The understanding of hospital staff concerning knowledge management is at a low level. The hospital manager should renew their commitment to knowledge management. Hospital employees should make much more effort to study the theory of knowledge management, and place their education standard on a sounder footing, in order to promote the progress of hospital knowledge management.

articleTitle: Study on the influencing factors of Trichoderma quantities in protected vegetable soils
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Soil texture, cultivating ages, vegetable species, and crop rotation system can influence the quantity and distribution of Trichoderma, which mainly distributes in neutral loam and light loam are humid, rich in organic matters, and have good aeration; the quantity of Trichoderma has a close relationship with cultivating ages and the planting structure of vegetables. In continuous cultivation, when the cultivating ages is more than 10 years, the quantity of Trichoderma decreases; compared with continuous cropping field, even though the number in rotation land decreases, its proportion shows increasing tendency in fungi; the quantity of Trichoderma in the fields planting vegetables like onions and garlic is more than that in fields planting cucumbers. In soil factors, the content of soil organic matters has the most important influence on the quantity of Trichoderma, which show the most significant level, with the regressive equation being Y= 0.13×-1.07.

articleTitle: Computer-based patient record data integration method based on ontology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Currently, Many hospitals have established their own CPR (Computer-Based Patient Record) systems. Under the trend of Internet globalization, how to integrate and share heterogeneous CPR has become one of the main problems that medical information construction faces. This paper presents a CPR data integration method based on hybrid ontology, which effectively eliminates the heterogeneity among CPR systems by means of constructing mapping, and provides a good basis for achieving the sharing of CPR data.

articleTitle: Method and theory of Grammar based data model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In the environment of large scale internetwork, data volume is very large and data schema is rapid evolving, data management has met some new and serious challenges. The paper proposes Grammar based data model(GDM), which represents many kinds of data models, such as relational data model, semi-structured data model and some picture data model. To formalize GDM data manipulation, we define GDM data manipulation logic based on monadic second order logic, at the same time we prove that there exists a linear algorithm of GDM data manipulation.

articleTitle: Comparison of balance ability of minimization, simple and stratified block randomization from true data of a clinical trial
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: Simple randomization, stratified block randomization and minimization are three most commonly used allocation methods in clinical trials. Our objective was to make a comparison of their balance ability from the true data of a clinical trial with a serials observational point from 50 to 1350 patients in 552 combined strata. Study design: We created random sequences by SAS plan program, and then allocated patients by MINI (Minimization), SB4 (Stratified Block randomization with block length of 4) and SR (Simple Randomization) when the sample size reach 50, 100, 300, 500, 800, 1000 and 1350 from a real clinical trial cohort and repeated 1000 times, standardized difference was used to evaluate the balance of baseline covariates. Results: When the number of subjects was small, minimization had the advantages against other two allocation methods. Stratified randomization achieved a slightly better balance result than simple randomization in given conditions. With the increasing number of patients, the difference between simple randomization and minimization or stratified block randomization decreased. Conclusions: We recommend minimization in small sample clinical trials when large number of combined strata exist, but prefer simple randomization when the sample size is large enough.

articleTitle: Incremental learning method of Bayesian classification combined with feedback information
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Owing to insufficiency of the training sets, the performance of the initial classifier is not satisfactory and can not track the users' needs. To the defect, the paper proposes an incremental learning method of Bayesian Classifier combined with feedback information. To improve representative ability of feedback feature subset, use an improved feature selection method based genetic algorithm to choose the best features from feedback sets to amend classifier. Analyze the performance of the algorithm by experiments. Experimental results show the algorithm optimizes the classification effect significantly and show better overall stability.

articleTitle: Study on life form and water ecotype of four plant communities in Daqinggou
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Field sampling systematic analysis and laboratory experiment were conducted in order to compare life form and water ecotype of four plant communities in Daqinggou. The result showed that hemicryptophyte, chamaephyte, phanerophyte, therophyte and geophyte plants accounted for 29.47%, 27.37%, 20.00%, 18.95% and 4.21% respectively in the composition of plant life form. In the composition of plant water ecotype of Daqinggou, mesophytic, xerophytic, mesophytic-xerophytic, xerophytic-mesophytic, wet-mesophytic, wet plants accounted for 62.11%, 12.63%, 10.53%, 6.23%, 4.21% and 4.21% respectively. Water ecotype of Fraxinus mandshurica community, Quercus mongolica community and Ulmus macrocarpa community was primarily mesophytic. Mesophytic plants had larger proportion in arbor, shrub and grass. Generally speaking, the composition characteristics of life form and water ecotype reflected the particularity of climate and environment in Daqinggou.

articleTitle: Stochastic dynamics of a Hepatitis B virus transmission model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Hepatitis B is an infectious disease caused by the Hepatitis B virus (HBV) and has caused epidemics in parts of Asia and Africa. During the last two decades, mathematical models have been designed to evaluate the effect of public health programs and provided long-term predictions regarding the disease prevalence and control. These mathematical models are dominantly deterministic because of the large population size. However, when considering elimination and eradication of the HBV, the demographic noise due to the inherent discreteness of individuals may play an important role in determining the dynamics of HBV infection. This work develops a stochastic model to study the influence of small number of infected individuals on the extinction of the disease. Simulation results suggested that, when the infected population size is small, there is disparity between the deterministic model using ordinary differential equations and the corresponding stochastic model. This research work suggested that stochastic modeling could provide a powerful tool to study the eradication of epidemic diseases.

articleTitle: Chemical composition and antioxidant activities of essential oil of Abelmoschus esculentus L. from different parts
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The volatile oil of leave, flower and seed of Abelmoschus esculentus L. was obtained by steam distillation. Their chemical components were separated and identified by gas chromatography (GC) and gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS). The amount and relative percentage content of the components from the volatile oil were determined by the area normalization method. The DPPH free radical scavenging activity (IC<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf>) of different parts volatile oil was tested by the use of trolox as a control. The results of experiments show that there are 43 compounds in flowers, 20 compounds in leaves, and 29 compounds in seeds. There are 11 compounds in common in the three parts of volatile oil. The volatile oils of different parts all have antioxidant activity, and the size of antioxidant capacity: flowers>leaves>seeds. The IC<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf> of the ability of scavenging DPPH free radical are respectively 3.652µL/mL, 5.170µL/mL, and 12.396µL/mL. The result of the experiment can provide reference for further research on the composition of Abelmoschus esculentus L. volatile oil as well as for the exploration and utilization of it.

articleTitle: Localization of S-lap/GFP fusion protein and its effect on cell cycle in 293T cells
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The s-lap is a novel gene discovered and cloned from the porcine retinal pigment epithelial cells which show earlier signs of apoptosis induced by visible light damage. However, its function is still unclear. To clarify the relationship between s-lap and apoptosis, we investigated the expression, localization of s-lap/GFP fusion protein and its effect on cell cycle in 293T cells. The plasmid expressing s-lap/GFP fusion protein was constructed and transfected into 293T cells. Then the expression and localization of s-lap/GFP fusion protein was observed by fluorescence microscope, and the effect on cell cycle were evaluated by FACS. The result shown that The recombinant plasmid can express s-lap/GFP fusion protein in 293T cells. The observation with fluorescence microscope showed that distributed of s-lap/GFP was shared in the entire cell but the priority of which was given to the nuclear, while the single GFP distributed in the cytoplasm. The cell cycle result indicated that the cell number in G2/M phase increased dramatically after s-lap/GFP transfection.

articleTitle: Research on college graduates working as village officials
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper conducts a deep research on the college graduates' attention and attitude towards serving rural areas, as well as the motivation and influencing factors for working as village officials, in methods of questionnaires, interviews, and seminars etc. Furthermore, specific countermeasures have been put forward in terms of strengthening the students cultivation, establishing a correct concept of employment, and making full use of university education and guidance, as well as establishing long-term mechanism of students serving rural areas.

articleTitle: Processing of simulated biosensor data using artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Probability artificial neural network (PNN) and back propagation neural network (BPNN) are used in processing of the simulated data of heavy metals biosensors. The probability artificial neural network is used in pattern recognition to determine the kinds of heavy metals in the sample. The back propagation neural network is used in prediction of the heavy metal concentrations. The results shows that these two artificial neural networks work well.

articleTitle: Multi-resistance analysis of secreted peroxidase from wintersweet (Chimonanthus praecox)
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Peroxidases play a critical role in the anti-oxidant enzyme protection system of plants accordingly, we assumed that wintersweet (Chimonanthus praecox), as a multi-resistant plant adapting to a variety of stressful conditions, should contain certain special peroxidase. In this study, a putative peroxidase cDNA containing a ORF (CpPOD) was cloned by screening the full-length cDNA library of wintersweet. In order to decipher the its function, the cloned gene was overexpressed in tobacco system via Agrobacterium-mediated transformation method. The results initially showed that overexpression of CpPOD can not only enhance the ability of water-keeping, but also provide anti-oxidant activity to stress injury. All these results suggested that the CpPOD gene presents multiple resistance actions.

articleTitle: Research on key technology of remote experimental platform for open network laboratory
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to satisfy the development of contemporary higher education better, after analyzing different experimental methods, this paper proposes a new idea to combine real laboratory equipments and virtual simulation system for building the remote experimental platform. Therefore students are no longer limited in the visible laboratory. As a result, the experimental resources can be made used of completely, the manual management can be reduced, the application of laboratory equipments can be improved efficiently.

articleTitle: Requirement-based teaching in interdisciplinary graduate courses: Student perceptions and achievement
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The teaching in interdisciplinary graduate courses has to face many challenges, such as the wide contents, the various backgrounds of students and the different professional basis. Here, we presented a requirement-based teaching method for interdisciplinary graduate courses and practiced in two professional courses for four years at the School of Biological Science and Medical Engineering in Beihang University. The main idea of this method was to combine the course teaching and degree program requirement of each student, which largely inspired the learning enthusiasm and made the students change from `let me study', `I want to study' to `study what I want'. The results showed that this teaching method improved the comprehensive abilities of students and accelerated the publication of professional paper in their graduate stages.

articleTitle: The application of information ideas and methods in the tongue diagnosis of tranditional Chinese medicine
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Tongue diagnosis is characteristic diagnosis method of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) and an important source of body pathology information using TCM to inspect disease essence The four diagnosis method of “Observe surface phenomenon Infer reason” and “See details know reason” reflect it's scientific and logical and contain the modern information ideas and methods in TCM.

articleTitle: Clinical test and verify of hemodynamic parameters based on the volume pulse wave hemodynamic detecting
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: In order to improve detection method of non-invasive pulse wave detector, taking into account the operation complexity of the radial artery test, a simple finger pulse detection are choose. Methods: Through a large number of clinical data analyses, the conversion relationship of the radial artery pulse detection and volume pulse wave detection was determined, hemodynamic parameters based on the volume pulse wave were calculated and test results were compared with results of echocardiography. Results: The differences of hemodynamic parameters detected by volume pulse and echocardiography were not statistically significant. Conclusion: It is showed that the application of cardiac output and other blood flow parameters detection by the method of volume pulse wave is feasible.

articleTitle: Isolation of alkai-soluble polysaccharide from Tremella Fuciformis and its antioxidant activity in vitro
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this study a kind of alkai-soluble polysaccharide in Tremella fuciformis was extracted and purified for the first time. Its structure and antioxidant activities were evaluated. It showed that alkai-soluble polysaccharide of Tremella fuciformis (ASTP) was with a molecular weight of 32.9 kD. The main monosaccharides in ASTP were β-type pyran configuration. ASTP showed higher antioxidant activity than hot water extracted polysaccharide in vitro and should be explored as a novel potential antioxidant.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of virtual assembly based repairing training system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the development of human-computer interaction and virtual reality technology, repairing training system based on virtual assembly reveals its advantage in repairing training education. Based on 3D interaction, virtual assembly and animation script, we propose a novel method to develop a new remote repairing training system which breaks the limitation of equipment, space and time, makes trainees study more conveniently, improves the preciseness of the system, and helps to improve trainees' practice quality and ability. Moreover, we present the system framework, elaborate the essential technologies in virtual environment-motion control, collision detection, localization and making assembling process and detail the service contained in the system.

articleTitle: Editing support system of teaching material for reusing catheterization movie
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Recently, previous studies have improved surgical simulations. As the technology improve, surgical simulations grow in diversity. Also, as the IT technology improve, learning support system for doctors such as e-learning began to expand. But doctors can't get errors such as unexpected bleed with surgical simulations and e-learning. Unexpected things are good one for adept doctors. This study focused on catheterization. The purpose of this study was to develop a support system for making teaching materials which can have unexpected error for doctors. Requirements analysis of attending was performed to determine system design. Request of attending involved to edit video without cutting and to be able to reduce burden of editing. Video data are videos of radioscopy, catheter operation, and close up doctor's hands. This study advanced and developed a support system of video teaching materials for catheter operation based on annotation such as title, category, playing position of category. This system satisfy needs of attending.

articleTitle: Study and practice based on computer-aided College English teaching
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Recently, computer has been one of the most favorite teaching tools in foreign language teaching in the universities and colleges. The use of computer makes the foreign language teaching more efficiently than the traditional teaching model. The author of this article tries to probe into the making of the software, the advantages and the practice of computer-aided college teaching and its possible problems in college English teaching.

articleTitle: Knowledge representation and design about expert system for learning-disability check for children
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Based on the introduction to the importance and uncertainty in knowledge representation of expert system for learning-disability diagnosis for children, this paper selects production representation and then elaborates it. Taking mathematical learning disabilities as an example, this study designs a knowledge base with access. The author hopes that it would to benefit the other expert systems on the aspects of theories and methods.

articleTitle: The effect of amino acids on porcin oocytes IVM and reconstructed embryonic early development
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The purpose of this study is to compare the effect of non-essential amino acids and essential amino acids on in vitro maturation and development of reconstructed embryos of porcine oocytes. The oocytes were divided into four groups, the IVM medium of porcine were added 1% the essential amino acids, 1% non-essential amino acids, both 1%essential and nonessential amino acids, And non amino acids as control. The oocytes were cultured for 44h, and statistics maturation rate. Embryo culture medium (NCSU-23) were added 1% the essential amino acids, 1% non-essential amino acids, both 1%essential and nonessential amino acids, And free amino acids as control. The reconstructed embryos were cultured to 7d, and statistics blastocysts rate. Each experiment was repeated three times. The results show that added any kind of amino acids in IVM medium will improve the oocytes maturation rate (P<;0.05), and the oocytes maturation rate of non-essential amino acid group was significantly higher than other groups (P<;0.05); The non-essential amino acids in NCSU-23 can significantly improve the reconstructed embryonic blastocysts rate (P<;0.05), while the essential amino acids or both essential and non essential amino acids in NCSU-23 leads blastocysts rate decreased (P<;0.05). The studies have shown that there are some different of the effect of essential and non essential amino acids on porcine oocytes IVM and reconstructed embryos development.

articleTitle: The empirical study about the main influencing factors of high-tech enterprises' performance based on the model of EVA
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Considering the features of higher-invest, higher - risk, higher -yield and higher-intelligence of high-tech enterprises, this paper analyzes the main influencing factors of high-tech enterprises' economic value added (EVA) performance and generalizes relevant empirical hypothesises. On the basis of that, this paper makes use of new performance appraisal method based on EVA to analyze performance of 111 Information Technology Industry listed companies. Finally, this paper makes relevant empirical study by the quantitative method.
